| Controller-card source-bundle schema | deferred_to_build_book + Phase 14/Layer 10 / optional/stretch clarification | Phase 10 can prepare source bundle but not final card schema | Defer final `CardRecord` rendering to Phase 14/Layer 10. |
| `SafetyEventRecord` versus safety-event log aliases | requires_registry_confirmation / diagnostic-only risk | Safety summary may be warning-only if linkage unclear | Use canonical name where materialized and preserve alias warning. |
| `MetricDictionaryEntry` / `MetricDictionary` paths and final entries | requires_registry_confirmation + deferred_to_final_experiment_protocol / claim-limiting | Metrics not thesis-ready without entries | Require entries before claim use. |
| `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` versus `ClaimEvidenceManifest` naming | requires_registry_confirmation / claim-limiting | Phase 15 claim linkage must preserve naming ambiguity | Preserve both names or explicit mapping until final registry resolves. |
| Dashboard/export route and ID conventions | deferred_to_build_book + Phase 14/Layer 10 / implementation-detail deferred | Phase 10 cannot define final UI routes/export IDs | Provide source bundle only. |
| Stress pointer/view naming inherited from Phase 9 | requires_registry_confirmation / diagnostic-only risk | Stress-conditioned A10 may be diagnostic if lineage cannot be resolved | Preserve Phase 9 matched keys and candidate status. |
| Optional embodiment reward terms | optional/stretch clarification + deferred_to_nuts_and_bolts for Phase 12/13 | A10 cannot claim embodiment-aware benefit | Defer to Phase 12/13 and Layer 9 records. |

### 16A. Back-Propagation Correction Request handling

No Back-Propagation Correction Request is opened in this generated Phase 10 section. The inherited issues above are source-documented open issues or future-document deferrals, not proven errors in the accepted Phase 0–9 playbook text.

Template to use if a grounded prior-phase defect is later discovered:

```yaml
back_propagation_request:
  request_id: "BPCR-P10-<sequence>"
  discovered_in_phase: "Phase 10 — Contextual bandit"
  affected_prior_phase: "<Phase ID and title>"
  affected_artifact_or_record: "<canonical artifact/record name or prior handoff item>"
  issue_type: "schema_gap | lineage_gap | validation_gap | source_conflict | claim_safety_gap | matched_key_gap | other"
  severity: "blocking | claim_limiting | diagnostic_only_risk | non_blocking"
  source_conflict: "<source anchors proving the issue>"
  downstream_risk: "<risk to Phase 10/11/14/15>"
  required_action: "<non-destructive correction, derived overlay, or explicit downgrade>"
  whether_current_phase_can_continue: "yes | yes_with_diagnostic_limit | no"
  diagnostic_only_effect: "<affected outputs/comparisons>"
  claim_safety_effect: "<affected claims/limitation tags>"
```

### 17. Definition of done

Actual Phase 10 execution is complete only when all applicable items below are satisfied or explicitly downgraded:

| Checklist item | Required status |
|---|---|
| Official phase identity and source document versions recorded | Required |
| Phase 0–9 input records and validation statuses loaded without mutation | Required |
| Clean versus stress-conditioned mode declared | Required |
| `ReadinessContextRecord` / context instances contain source IDs and legal observable fields only | Required |
| Action-space and legality-mask versions declared | Required |
| Reward/cost config version/hash declared before evaluation | Required |
| Update-enabled training/adaptation separated from frozen held-out evaluation | Required if updates are used |
| `PolicyUpdateTrace` complete for every mutation | Required if updates are used |
| Disabled-update/no-mutation audit present for frozen evaluation | Required for frozen claim |
| Held-out sessions/seeds/subjects/stress profiles separated where claims require generalization | Required for generalization/frozen superiority claims |
| Bandit `PolicyActionRecord` rows emitted and linked to context/action/reward IDs | Required |
| A10 Layer 7 records emitted and validated | Required for empirical A10 |
| Comparators A0–A9/best-fixed included where valid or missingness disclosed | Required |
| `MatchedComparisonReport` produced for any comparison claim | Required |
| Metric dictionary entries attached to thesis-facing metrics | Required |
| Negative/flat/unsafe/reward-sensitive/seed-sensitive outcomes preserved in `NegativeResultNote` | Required where applicable |
| `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` attached to incomplete/invalid outputs | Required where applicable |
| Layer 10 source bundle includes lineage, warnings, metrics, matched reports, config hashes, seeds, and limitation tags | Required |
| Layer 0 claim-safety handoff includes allowed/forbidden claims and limitation labels | Required |
| Back-propagation need checked | Required |
| Open issues and deferrals visible | Required |
| No invented canonical names, phases, layers, modules, ablation IDs, metrics, paths, commands, classes, or final thesis claims | Required |

### 19. Source-grounding ledger

| Source anchor | Use in Phase 10 section |
|---|---|
| [FRAME: required phase-section structure] | Controls section ordering, digest, gates, handoff, YAML, ledger, domain non-interference, and self-audit. |
| [FRAME: cumulative playbook behavior] | Requires Phase 0–9 preservation and append-only Phase 10 behavior. |
| [FRAME: immutable/versioned discipline] | Controls upstream immutability, derived/versioned outputs, and correction-request handling. |
| [FRAME: domain non-interference] | Blocks invented architecture, records, run matrices, implementation paths, commands, test names, or thesis wording. |
| [ARCH: Layer 6 / Adaptive Readiness Policy Layer] | Supports Phase 10 owner, purpose, context/action/reward logic, staged policy learning, and simulation-only adaptation. |
| [ARCH: Layer 6 / Submodule 6.4 Contextual bandit policy] | Supports immediate-reward contextual-bandit purpose, action modes, outputs, and comparison role before RL. |
| [ARCH: Layer 7 / Simulated Closed-Loop Readiness Environment] | Supports transition/reward/session/rollout/safety/diagnostic ownership and A10 simulation substrate. |
| [ARCH: Layer 8 / StressForge-Lite] | Supports conditional stress input and stress-conditioned claim boundary. |
| [ARCH: Layer 9 / MyoSuite/OpenSim Embodiment Demo] | Supports downstream optional compatibility and no A13 claim in Phase 10. |
| [ARCH: Layer 10 / dashboard cards reproducibility] | Supports read-only dashboard/export/card/reproducibility handoff. |
| [ARCH: Layer 0 / claim-safety] | Supports allowed/forbidden claim classes and limitation tags. |
| [REG: Layer 6 module inventory] | Supports `6.4 Contextual bandit policy`, update permissions, outputs, and phase/ablation linkage. |
| [REG: Layer 7 module inventory] | Supports StateAssembler, PolicyAdapter, ActionValidator, RewardEngine, PolicyUpdateHook, TransitionLogger, PolicyComparisonHarness, and diagnostics. |
| [REG: `ReadinessContextRecord`] | Supports context fields, source IDs, split/seed/config, lifecycle, and ownership nuance. |
| [REG: `PolicyActionRecord`] | Supports bandit action rows, action probabilities, legality masks, cost/reward IDs, and matched keys. |
| [REG: `PolicyUpdateTrace`] | Supports update trace requirement, trace fields, storage family, and diagnostic effect. |

#### 0A. Source Extraction Digest

##### 0A.1 Master Architecture Specification extraction

| Source anchor | Extracted operational facts for Phase 11 |
|---|---|
| [ARCH: Layer 6 / Adaptive Readiness Policy Layer] | Layer 6 owns the policy-learning plane and stages policy complexity from evidence-quality estimation through supervised Adaptive-IHARQ, learning-to-defer, contextual bandit, and finally RL. Phase 11 must preserve that staging and must not present RL as mandatory core evidence. |
| [ARCH: Layer 6 / Submodule 6.5 Reinforcement-learning readiness policy] | RL is justified only when consequences are delayed. It must define state, action space, reward hierarchy, transition interface, training/evaluation split, baseline policies, unsafe penalties, and controller-card source content. It starts with a small action space and expands only after stable results. |
| [ARCH: Layer 6 / Submodule 6.4 Contextual bandit policy] | Contextual bandit is the simpler immediate-reward adaptation baseline that Phase 11 must compare against where Phase 10 produced validated A10 evidence. |
| [ARCH: Layer 7 / Simulated Closed-Loop Readiness Environment] | Layer 7 owns environment, transitions, reward traces, session/episode/rollout records, environment diagnostics, safety/proxy events where materialized, and the policy-update hook. Phase 11 RL cannot claim evidence unless Layer 7 simulation and reward logging are stable. |
| [ARCH: `PolicyUpdateTrace`] | Every simulation-authorized policy mutation must be traceable; frozen evaluation requires no-mutation or disabled-update audit evidence. Missing trace blocks update-enabled RL claims. |
| [ARCH: feed-forward and bounded loopback contracts] | Normal path is upstream evidence → readiness context → policy action → Layer 7 transition/reward/session records → optional stress/embodiment contexts → Layer 10/Layer 0. Feedback is allowed only through declared simulation/update paths. |
| [ARCH: Layer 8 / StressForge-Lite] | Stress-conditioned Phase 11 evidence may only consume valid Phase 9 stress records and matched clean/stressed keys; Phase 11 must not invent stress definitions. |
| [ARCH: Layer 9 / MyoSuite/OpenSim Embodiment Demo] | Embodiment-aware reward or context is optional downstream context requiring Layer 9 records in later phases. Phase 11 does not produce embodiment records. |
| [ARCH: Layer 10 / Dashboard, Cards, and Reproducibility] | Layer 10 reads saved records, renders cards/views, exports manifests, surfaces warnings, and packages reproducibility artifacts. It must not train, retune, repair, or silently promote diagnostic RL outputs. |
| [ARCH: Layer 0 / Claim-Safety and Scope Governance] | Phase 11 may only support public-data/proxy/simulation-only, evaluation-only, reward-model-bound policy-learning claims. It must block clinical, deployment, medical-device, real-patient-safety, real rehabilitation, real stimulation, and real assistive-control claims. |

#### 1. Phase identity, scope, and non-scope

| Field | Phase 11 value |
|---|---|
| Phase ID | `Phase 11` |
| Official phase title | `Reinforcement-learning policy` |
| Official sequence position | After `Phase 10 — Contextual bandit`; before `Phase 12 — MyoSuite embodiment demo`. |
| Primary owning layer | Layer 6 — Adaptive Readiness Policy Layer. |
| Required environment owner | Layer 7 — Simulated Closed-Loop Readiness Environment. |
| Supporting layers | Layers 1–5 as immutable upstream source/evidence providers; Layer 8 only for stress-conditioned A11; Layer 9 only as optional downstream embodiment context after Phase 12/13; Layer 10 as later read/export/card/reproducibility owner; Layer 0 as claim-safety owner. |
| Primary evaluation linkage | `A11 — reinforcement-learning policy`. |
| Phase type | Stretch C, public-data/proxy-readiness, simulation-only, delayed-consequence policy-learning phase. |
| Claim boundary | Supports bounded simulation-only evaluation of sequential policy behavior under declared reward/cost models and held-out frozen rollouts; does not support clinical or deployment claims. |

**Thesis role.** Phase 11 asks whether delayed-consequence sequential policy learning adds defensible value beyond simpler validated policy families. Its strongest positive result would be trace-complete, held-out, matched, reward/seed-stable, simulation-only A11 evidence. Its equally valid negative result would show that RL is unstable, reward-sensitive, unsafe in proxy simulation, or unnecessary relative to simpler baselines. [ARCH: Layer 6 / Submodule 6.5] [EXEC: Phase 11 purpose] [EVAL: A11 identity]

**In scope.** Phase 11 may define and execute RL readiness-policy evidence production at the phase level: state/context intake, action-space selection, reward/cost governance, policy-update tracing, transition/reward/session/rollout evaluation, held-out frozen evaluation, matched comparison, sensitivity checks, diagnostics, Layer 10 source bundle, and Layer 0 claim boundary. [ARCH: Layer 6 / Layer 7] [REG: Layers 6–7 records]

**Out of scope.** Phase 11 must not finalize exact RL algorithms, hyperparameter grids, seed counts, statistical tests, CLI commands, repository class names, dashboard routes, final figure/table numbering, final thesis wording, or clinical/device interpretations. Those remain deferred to the Detailed Design / Nuts-and-Bolts Specification, Implementation Build Book, final Experiment/Ablation/Evaluation Protocol, Phase 14 dashboard build, and Phase 15 evidence map. [FRAME: domain non-interference]

#### 1A. Capability-tier and thesis-validity relevance

| Capability tier relevance | Phase 11 implication |
|---|---|
| C0/C1/C2 | Phase 11 is not required to preserve lower-tier thesis validity based on public-data protocol, decoder/calibration/uncertainty, IHARQ, RegimeRisk, supervised policy, or simulated-readiness evidence. |
| C3 | Phase 11 can strengthen C3-style simulation-bounded policy-learning evidence only if Layer 7 environment stability, update/frozen separation, matched comparison, metrics, and claim-safety gates pass. |
| C4 | Phase 11 alone does not establish C4-style embodiment demonstration. C4 requires later Layer 9/Phase 12–13 embodiment records and their own gates. |
| Negative result relevance | A negative, flat, unstable, reward-sensitive, unsafe, or baseline-inferior RL result is still thesis-useful if recorded as `NegativeResultNote`, linked to diagnostics, and not hidden. |

| Reward/cost config | Versioned and frozen before evaluation. | Unversioned or post-hoc reward tuning invalidates reward claims. |

##### 2.3 Continuity decision

Phase 11 can be appended and executed as a bounded playbook section because the supplied Phase 0–10 playbook contains the necessary upstream phase handoff structure. No previous phase text is edited. Any future actual-execution defect in accepted prior content must be handled by a Back-Propagation Correction Request, validation overlay, diagnostic flag, or new versioned output rather than by silent mutation. [FRAME: cumulative playbook behavior] [PRIOR: Phase 10 handoff]

#### 3. Architecture-grounded phase objective

Phase 11’s objective is to produce a traceable RL policy-evaluation package that answers a narrow delayed-consequence question:

> Under a declared Layer 7 simulated closed-loop environment, frozen reward/cost configuration, legal action space, and held-out frozen rollout evaluation, does an RL readiness policy improve sequential reward/consequence behavior compared with simpler validated baselines, or does it fail in a way that is scientifically informative?

[DERIVED from ARCH: Layer 6 / Submodule 6.5, ARCH: Layer 7, EXEC: Phase 11 purpose, EVAL: A11 identity]

The objective is satisfied by either positive or negative evidence if the evidence is complete, matched, metric-defined, limitation-tagged, and exportable. RL superiority is not a definition-of-done requirement. [EVAL: Negative-result discipline]

#### 4. Input contract

##### 4.1 Mandatory input validation before RL execution

1. Verify all source records have schema version, validation status, run/config/seed lineage, source-record IDs, phase ID, and ablation/evaluation linkage where applicable. [REG: universal lineage envelope]
2. Validate `ReadinessContextRecord` decision-time observability: hidden labels, future correctness, future reward, future next state, future stress outcome, and future embodiment outcome must not be policy-visible. [REG: `ReadinessContextRecord`] [EVAL: leakage constraints]
3. Validate Phase 8 environment records and invariants before using them for RL. [EXEC: Phase 11 validation gates]
4. Validate action-space version, legality-mask ID, action map, fallback/no-action/unsafe handling, and canonical IHARQ token preservation. [ARCH: Layer 6 / action space] [REG: `PolicyActionRecord`]
5. Validate reward/cost config version, reward term version, hash, component-sum check, and held-out lockout. [REG: `RewardTraceRecord`] [EVAL: reward freeze]
6. Validate Phase 10 contextual-bandit baseline status; if unavailable, create a missing-baseline limitation and block “better than bandit” claims. [PRIOR: Phase 10 handoff] [EVAL: A10/A11]
7. Validate Phase 9 stress lineage only if Phase 11 intends a stress-conditioned claim. [PRIOR: Phase 9 handoff]
8. Validate Layer 10 and Layer 0 output hooks before thesis-facing use. [ARCH: Layer 10] [ARCH: Layer 0]

##### 4.2 Forbidden inputs

Phase 11 must not use any of the following as ordinary policy-visible decision-time features:

- true labels;
- decoder correctness;
- future rewards;
- future transition/next-state fields;
- future stress outcomes;
- future embodiment outcomes;
- oracle actions except in explicitly diagnostic/evaluation-only analysis;
- post-hoc reward weights selected on held-out outcomes;
- dashboard-edited records or manually repaired evidence;
- real-patient, clinical, device, stimulation, rehabilitation, or deployment fields not supported by the public-data/proxy/simulation architecture.

The following procedure is [DERIVED] from the architecture, registry, execution plan, evaluation protocol, and accepted prior handoffs. It is intentionally procedural rather than algorithmic: it tells the executor what evidence must be loaded, generated, checked, downgraded, and handed off, without defining final RL internals, commands, repository classes, hyperparameter grids, or final statistical run matrices. ##### 5.2 Minimal and strong execution modes

| Mode | Required minimum | Claim status |
|---|---|---|
| Diagnostic/minimal RL | Small declared action space, valid or explicitly diagnostic Layer 7 environment, traceable training/adaptation where mutation occurs, basic held-out attempt or explicit missing-held-out note, negative/diagnostic labels. | Diagnostic or limited simulation evidence only. |
| Thesis-ready A11 | Valid Phase 8 environment, trace-complete updates, held-out frozen evaluation/no-mutation audit, matched A0–A10 comparisons where available, metric dictionary entries, reward/seed sensitivity, visible negative-result handling, Layer 10/Layer 0 handoff. | Bounded simulation-only A11 evidence. |
| Stress-conditioned A11 | Thesis-ready A11 plus valid Phase 9 stress profiles/schedules/manifests and clean/stressed matched keys. | Stress-conditioned, simulation-only, A12-linked context; not real-world robustness. |
| Embodiment-aware variant | Downstream-only after Phase 12/13 creates Layer 9 records and declares reward/context feedback. | Optional proxy embodiment context; not Phase 11-owned and not real motor-control evidence. |

Phase 11 must not claim to produce or own:

- `CalibrationRecord`, `UncertaintyRecord`, `ThresholdRegistryRecord`, or `SelectivePredictionRecord`;
- `IHARQDecisionRecord` or upstream IHARQ canonical decisions;
- `RegimeStateRecord` / `TrustStateRecord` as source records;
- `StressProfileRecord` or `StressScheduleRecord`;
- `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, `Layer9RewardTrace`, or `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest`;
- Layer 10 final dashboard routes, final cards, final exported figures/tables, or final `ReproducibilityManifest` package;
- final thesis claims or clinical/deployment evidence.

#### 7. Artifact immutability, versioning rules, and lifecycle matrix

##### 7.1 Artifact immutability and versioning rules

Phase 11 must treat accepted prior-phase outputs and validated upstream records as immutable evidence inputs. RL training, reward tuning, stress conditioning, dashboard filtering, or manual repair must never overwrite Phase 0–10 source records. Any Phase 11 correction must be represented as a derived/versioned output, validation overlay, diagnostic flag, exclusion note, negative-result note, or Back-Propagation Correction Request rather than as a silent mutation. [FRAME: immutable/versioned discipline] [REG: clean-source immutability] [PRIOR: Phase 0–10 handoffs]

Phase 11 may produce or prepare the following non-destructive evidence types:

- derived or run-specific context views linked to `ReadinessContextRecord` lineage;
- versioned RL policy artifacts and action-space/reward/environment configurations;
- RL `PolicyActionRecord` rows that preserve source IHARQ/policy tokens rather than rewriting them;
- `PolicyUpdateTrace` records or disabled-update/no-mutation audit evidence for update governance;
- Layer 7 transition/reward/session/episode/rollout records linked to RL policy execution;
- evaluation overlays such as `EvaluationOutcomeRecord`, `MatchedComparisonReport`, metric references, reward/seed sensitivity outputs, `NegativeResultNote`, and `DiagnosticOnlyFlag`;
- Layer 10 and Layer 0 handoff inputs, including controller-card source bundle material, claim-evidence entries, and reproducibility manifest inputs.

Each Phase 11-derived or Phase 11-prepared output must carry source-record IDs, run/config/seed hashes, schema/version metadata, validation status, ablation/evaluation ID, diagnostic-only status where applicable, and public-data/proxy/simulation-only claim-boundary tags. Missing lineage, missing validation status, or missing limitation tags prevents claim-ready use and requires downgrade or blocking under Section 8. [REG: universal lineage envelope] [EXEC: Phase 11 validation gates] [EVAL: A11 diagnostic-only triggers]

#### 8. Validation gates and exit conditions

##### 8.1 Required validation gates

| Gate ID | Gate | Required check | Failure consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| G11.1 | Phase 0 inheritance | Schema/config/validator/run/hash/seed/manifest/metric/claim foundations exist or are gap-logged. | Block or diagnostic-only. |
| G11.2 | Source lineage | All consumed records preserve source IDs and split lineage. | Block thesis-facing use. |
| G11.3 | Clean-source immutability | RL, simulation, stress, dashboard, or manual repair does not overwrite upstream records. | Invalid evidence if violated. |
| G11.4 | Readiness-context leakage | No hidden label, future correctness, future reward, future next state, or future embodiment outcome is policy-visible. | Invalid run. |
| G11.5 | Phase 8 environment stability | Environment API, transition/reward/session/rollout/diagnostic records exist and pass invariants. | Blocks thesis-facing A11. |
| G11.6 | Action-space declaration | RL action space is declared, versioned, and mapped to canonical/source-supported actions. | Diagnostic-only or blocked. |
| G11.7 | Legality mask | Every action is legality-checked before application. | Illegal action blocks/downgrades rollout. |
| G11.8 | Reward/cost config | Reward weights/costs are declared, versioned, hashed, and frozen before held-out evaluation. | Diagnostic-only or invalid if post-hoc. |
| G11.9 | Update trace | Every update-enabled mutation emits `PolicyUpdateTrace`. | Update-enabled A11 invalid. |
| G11.10 | Transition-update linkage | Transitions link to update traces where applicable. | Update analysis diagnostic-only. |
| G11.11 | Frozen evaluation/no mutation | Held-out evaluation uses frozen policy and disabled-update/no-mutation audit. | Held-out claim invalid if mutation occurs. |
| G11.12 | Curve separation | Training/adaptation curves are stored/exported separately from frozen-evaluation curves. | Dashboard/thesis use blocked if mixed. |
| G11.13 | Held-out sessions | Held-out subjects/sessions/seeds/stress profiles exist where claims require them. | Generalization/stress claim narrowed or blocked. |
| G11.14 | Baseline sufficiency | Compare against strongest validated non-RL and bandit baselines available; disclose missing baselines. | Superiority claims blocked/narrowed. |
| G11.15 | Matched comparison | Same sessions, splits, seeds/seed policy, reward configs, stress profiles, horizons, and metrics where applicable. | Unmatched rows diagnostic-only. |
| G11.16 | Stress lineage | Stress-conditioned claims use valid Phase 9 stress records and clean/stressed matched keys. | No stress-conditioned claim. |
| G11.17 | Reward sensitivity | Reward ablations test ranking stability under declared alternatives. | Reward-sensitive claims downgraded. |
| G11.18 | Seed stability | Seed/policy-stability checks support stability claims. | Unstable/under-sampled results diagnostic-only. |
| G11.19 | Simple-RL escalation | Simple RL baseline and small action space exist before broader/opaque variants are used. | Complex variants remain diagnostic/future-work. |
| G11.20 | Controller-card source bundle | Reward, action, safety, update/frozen status, instability, limitations, and source links are captured. | Card/dashboard use blocked or diagnostic-only. |
| G11.21 | Safety-event linkage | Safety/unsafe/invalid-action summaries link to canonical or manifest-mapped safety logs/records. | Safety summaries warning-only/diagnostic. |
| G11.22 | Metric dictionary | Thesis-facing metrics have `MetricDictionaryEntry` references. | Metrics diagnostic-only. |
| G11.23 | Negative-result preservation | Negative, flat, unstable, unsafe, or overfit outcomes are preserved. | Final claim use blocked if hidden. |
| G11.24 | Dashboard/export | Layer 10 receives source records, configs, metrics, warnings, limitations, manifests only. | Dashboard use blocked if lineage missing. |
| G11.25 | Claim safety | Layer 0 limitation and non-claim boundaries are attached. | Claims blocked/downgraded. |

##### 8.2 Exit criteria

Phase 11 exits successfully when all of the following are true or explicitly downgraded:

- A11 evidence package is produced or the absence/failure of RL is documented as a negative/diagnostic result.
- Held-out frozen-evaluation evidence is separated from training/adaptation evidence.
- Update-enabled evidence has complete `PolicyUpdateTrace` lineage.
- Frozen evaluation has no-mutation/disabled-update audit evidence.
- RL is compared against strongest available baselines under matched keys.
- Metrics are dictionary-defined or marked diagnostic-only.
- Reward and seed sensitivity are visible.
- Stress-conditioned claims are made only with valid Phase 9 lineage.
- Layer 10 handoff contains dashboard/card/export/reproducibility source inputs and warnings.
- Layer 0 handoff contains allowed/forbidden claim boundaries, limitation tags, negative-result notes, diagnostic-only flags, and claim-evidence pointers.

RL superiority is not required.

#### 10. Ablation and evaluation obligations

##### 10.1 A0–A13 obligations

| Evaluation ID | Phase 11 relationship | Required handling |

| `A0 — raw decoder baseline` | Upstream baseline context. | Preserve source lineage; compare only through matched downstream metrics where meaningful. |
| `A1 — calibrated decoder baseline` | Calibration baseline context. | Preserve calibrated score/metric lineage. |
| `A2 — simple registered threshold / confidence-threshold baseline` | Static threshold comparator. | Use registered threshold lineage; no post-hoc threshold tuning. |
| `A3 — uncertainty and selective prediction` | Uncertainty/selective comparator context. | Preserve matched coverage/cost keys. |
| `A4 — longer-window, multi-window voting/averaging, and ordinary ensemble controls` | Ordinary control comparator where available. | Keep A4 as ordinary control, not RL evidence. |
| `A5 — IHARQ-lite` | Required reference baseline where available. | Compare against IHARQ-lite decisions without renaming source tokens. |
| `A6 — IHARQ + evidence-quality estimator` | Evidence-quality-aware context/baseline. | Consume valid Phase 6 outputs; do not produce A6. |
| `A7 — IHARQ + RegimeRisk` | Regime-aware comparator/context where active. | Preserve RegimeRisk causal cutoff and stop-loss limitations. |
| `A8 — learning-to-defer` | Strong non-RL deferral baseline. | Required comparator where Phase 7 valid. |
| `A9 — supervised Adaptive-IHARQ` | Strong non-RL learned-policy baseline. | Required comparator where Phase 6 valid. |
| `A10 — contextual bandit` | Immediate-reward adaptive baseline. | Required for “beyond bandit” claims where Phase 10 valid; missing/diagnostic A10 narrows claims. |
| `A11 — reinforcement-learning policy` | Direct evaluation-use metadata for Phase 11. | Primary obligation; A11 itself does not own records. |
| `A12 — stress tests` | Conditional stress-conditioned context. | Use only valid Phase 9 stress records; Phase 11 does not produce A12 stress definitions. |
| `A13 — MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay embodiment demonstration` | Downstream optional compatibility only. | No A13 output in Phase 11; embodiment-aware variants require Phase 12/13 Layer 9 records. |

##### 10.3 Metric families to prepare for Layer 10

Phase 11 must prepare metric dictionary entries or references for:

- cumulative/episode return under declared reward config;
- held-out frozen rollout reward;
- wrong-accept rate;
- unsafe/proxy-event count or rate where materialized;
- wait/request/fallback/no-action burden;
- request count and delay burden;
- task success or late-assist proxy where defined by simulation;
- comparison against best-fixed policy or regret where defined;
- reward sensitivity outcomes;
- seed/policy stability outcomes;
- stress-conditioned clean-versus-stressed deltas where valid;
- diagnostic-only rate and invalid-run count.

Undefined metric formulas, denominators, directionality, or aggregation levels must remain diagnostic-only until metric dictionary entries validate. [REG: `MetricDictionaryEntry`] [EVAL: A11 metric families]

##### 11.1 Layer 10 dashboard visibility

Layer 10 must not train RL, retune reward weights, mutate policy artifacts, repair missing traces, recompute hidden evidence, suppress negative results, or promote diagnostic-only records. [ARCH: Layer 10]

#### 12. Claim-safety and limitation boundaries

##### 12.1 Allowed bounded claim classes

Phase 11 may support only claims of the following form when all relevant gates pass:

- RL policy was evaluated in a declared simulated Layer 7 environment using public-data/proxy readiness records.
- RL did or did not improve delayed-consequence simulated reward relative to matched simpler baselines under declared reward/cost assumptions.
- RL was stable or unstable across declared seed/policy-stability checks.
- RL was robust or fragile under declared Phase 9 stress profiles, if stress lineage validated.
- RL was reward-sensitive or reward-stable under declared reward sensitivity checks.
- RL was unnecessary because simpler baselines matched or exceeded it under the declared evaluation.

##### 12.2 Required limitation tags

Phase 11 outputs must carry the relevant tags:

```text
public_eeg_only
proxy_readiness
simulation_only
evaluation_only
policy_learning_stretch
delayed_consequence_simulation
declared_reward_model_only
held_out_frozen_evaluation_required
update_enabled_training_only where applicable
frozen_policy_evaluation where applicable
stress_conditioned_only where applicable
embodiment_proxy_only only after valid Phase 12/13 Layer 9 records
not_clinical_validation
not_real_patient_safety
not_medical_device_readiness
not_real_rehabilitation_efficacy
not_real_muscle_stimulation_control
not_real_assistive_control_safety
not_deployment_readiness
diagnostic_only where applicable
```

##### 12.3 Forbidden claim classes

Phase 11 must not claim:

- clinical BCI-FES validation;
- real patient safety;
- medical-device readiness;
- real rehabilitation efficacy;
- real muscle stimulation control;
- real assistive-control safety;
- real deployment readiness;
- real online patient adaptation;
- real physiological fatigue or stress validation;
- RL superiority without matched, held-out, frozen, trace-complete evidence;
- robustness beyond declared stress profiles;
- embodiment or OpenSim/MyoSuite evidence before Phase 12/13 records exist.

##### 12.4 Evidence required before any stronger claim

Any stronger-than-simulation-only claim would require source evidence not present in the provided documents: real online BCI data, real device/stimulation control validation, clinical safety protocols, medical-device verification, patient/participant validation, and Layer 0 approval. Therefore stronger claims are blocked in this playbook section. [ARCH: Layer 0]

#### 13. Failure, missingness, and diagnostic-only handling

| Failure or missingness case | Required handling | Diagnostic-only / invalid effect |
|---|---|---|
| Missing Phase 8 environment records | Block thesis-facing A11; record environment gap. | Diagnostic-only or blocked. |
| Invalid `ReadinessContextRecord` lineage | Rerun context assembly or block affected records. | Diagnostic-only if used. |
| Hidden label/future reward/future state leakage | Exclude run; create diagnostic/failure note. | Invalid run. |
| Missing action legality mask | Block action selection or restrict to safe fallback action space. | Diagnostic-only or invalid. |
| Illegal action selected | Block thesis-facing result; log safety/illegal-action event. | Diagnostic-only / failed rollout. |
| Unversioned reward/cost config | Add version/hash or exclude result. | Reward claim diagnostic-only. |
| Post-hoc reward tuning on held-out outcomes | Create new run/config; exclude old result from claim-facing evidence. | Invalid run. |
| Missing `PolicyUpdateTrace` for mutation | Block update-enabled claim. | Invalid update-enabled A11 evidence. |
| Missing transition-update linkage | Link records or downgrade update analysis. | Diagnostic-only update evidence. |
| Mutation during held-out frozen evaluation | Rerun frozen evaluation or reclassify as online adaptation. | Invalid frozen evaluation. |
| Missing disabled-update/no-mutation audit | Add audit or downgrade frozen claim. | Diagnostic-only / blocked. |
| Mixed training/adaptation and frozen-evaluation curves | Separate curves or block dashboard/thesis export. | Invalid export / diagnostic-only. |
| Missing held-out sessions | Limit to in-sample/training behavior. | No held-out performance claim. |
| Missing A10 contextual-bandit baseline | State baseline gap and narrow claim. | No “better than bandit” claim. |
| Missing A8/A9 or other strong baselines | Create missing-baseline note. | Superiority narrowed. |
| Missing `MatchedComparisonReport` | Produce report or downgrade. | No comparative claim. |
| Missing `MetricDictionaryEntry` | Define metric entry or mark metric diagnostic-only. | Metric diagnostic-only. |
| Reward sensitivity changes conclusion | Report sensitivity and narrow claim. | Reward-model-dependent limitation. |
| Seed instability | Report instability and narrow claim. | Stability/superiority blocked. |
| Missing Phase 9 stress lineage for stress claim | Remove stress claim or mark diagnostic. | Stress-conditioned claim blocked. |
| Safety-event alias/path unresolved | Manifest-map and keep warning visible. | Warning-only/diagnostic if material. |
| Missing negative-result note | Add `NegativeResultNote`; do not hide failure. | Claim blocked until repaired. |
| Missing diagnostic-only flag | Add `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` to affected records. | Claim blocked until visible. |
| Missing Layer 10 export/source lineage | Prepare source bundle or block dashboard export. | Dashboard-only diagnostic. |
| Clinical/deployment wording | Remove or rewrite to allowed simulation-only wording. | Invalid claim. |

Diagnostic-only Phase 11 outputs may be kept for engineering, thesis limitations, failure analysis, and future-work discussion. They must be visibly marked and cannot be used to support stronger A11 claims. [EVAL: diagnostic-only triggers]

| Negative/diagnostic overlays | `NegativeResultNote`, `DiagnosticOnlyFlag`. | Must be visible to Layer 10 and Layer 0. |

#### 15. Phase handoff package

##### 15.1 Handoff to Phase 12 — MyoSuite embodiment demo

Phase 11 hands Phase 12 validated or diagnostic RL policy outputs only as readiness-gated simulated policy actions: RL policy artifact, RL `PolicyActionRecord` rows, action-space/legality/reward/config/seed lineage, frozen/update mode, safety/proxy warnings, negative notes, diagnostic flags, and limitation tags. Phase 12 must create and own any `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, `Layer9RewardTrace`, or `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest`. Phase 11 policy outputs must not be treated as real motor-control, stimulation, rehabilitation, or patient-safety evidence. [ARCH: Layer 9]

##### 15.2 Handoff to Phase 13 — OpenSim replay or optional comparison

Phase 13 may consume Phase 11 outputs only if the optional replay/comparison branch explicitly declares RL policy/action lineage and preserves simulation-only/proxy-only limitations. Phase 11 does not produce OpenSim replay evidence. [EXEC: downstream handoff]

##### 15.3 Handoff to Phase 14 — Dashboard and cards

Phase 14 receives dashboard-readable source records, controller-card source bundles, training/frozen curve separation, reward/seed sensitivity source tables, stress-conditioned source tables where valid, update-trace completeness reports, disabled-update audit reports, matched comparison reports, metric dictionary references, negative notes, diagnostic flags, warning inputs, and reproducibility/export manifest inputs. Phase 14 must not repair or reinterpret Phase 11 evidence. [ARCH: Layer 10]

##### 15.4 Handoff to Phase 15 — Final thesis integration

Phase 15 receives A11 claim-evidence candidates only with Layer 0 boundaries. It may use positive, negative, or diagnostic Phase 11 evidence according to validation status. It must preserve public-data/proxy/simulation-only wording and cannot upgrade RL to clinical, deployment, or real-device evidence. [ARCH: Layer 0]

##### 16A. Back-Propagation Correction Request handling

No grounded Back-Propagation Correction Request is opened by this generated Phase 11 section. The accepted Phase 0–10 playbook provides the required handoff boundaries, and the unresolved items above are source-documented open issues or future-document deferrals rather than contradictions requiring prior text mutation.

If actual Phase 11 execution discovers that a prior accepted phase is incomplete, inconsistent, stale, invalid, or insufficient in a way that affects Phase 11 validity, the executor must preserve prior text and emit a request using this structure:

```yaml
back_propagation_request:
  request_id: "BPCR-P11-<sequence>"
  discovered_in_phase: "Phase 11"
  affected_prior_phase: "<Phase ID>"
  affected_artifact_or_record: "<canonical record/artifact/interface>"
  issue_type: "schema_gap | lineage_gap | validation_gap | matched_comparison_gap | claim_safety_gap | other_source_grounded_issue"
  severity: "blocking | claim_limiting | diagnostic_only | warning"
  source_conflict: "<source anchors showing the conflict>"
  downstream_risk: "<risk to Phase 11/12/14/15/Layer 0>"
  required_action: "<non-destructive repair/versioned overlay/validation rerun>"
  whether_current_phase_can_continue: "yes_with_diagnostic_downgrade | no_until_repaired | yes_unaffected"
  diagnostic_only_effect: "<affected outputs>"
  claim_safety_effect: "<affected claims/limitations>"
```

#### 20. Domain non-interference notes

- This section does not redesign Layer 6, Layer 7, Layer 8, Layer 9, Layer 10, or Layer 0; it operationalizes Phase 11 within the source-defined architecture. [ARCH]
- This section does not invent canonical records or artifacts. Where output names are source-supported but not fully schema-final, they are treated as artifacts, source bundles, validation overlays, diagnostic logs, or open issues rather than new canonical records. [REG]
- This section does not redefine Phase 0–15; it uses the official `Phase 11 — Reinforcement-learning policy` identity. [EXEC]
- This section does not redefine A0–A13; A11 remains reinforcement-learning policy evaluation metadata, A12 is conditional stress context, A13 is downstream embodiment context, and no A14 appears. [EVAL]
- This section does not create final seeds, run counts, reward-weight grids, statistical tests, or RL algorithm/hyperparameter grids. Those remain deferred. [FRAME] [EVAL]
- This section does not provide implementation commands, repository class names, test-suite names, dashboard route IDs, final export IDs, final thesis figure/table numbers, or paper-ready claims. [FRAME]
- This section respects the special A6 boundary: Phase 11 consumes valid Phase 6 A6/evidence-quality outputs where available but does not produce A6. [EVAL]
- This section keeps dashboard/cards/static outputs read-only and derived; Layer 10 is not an evidence repair or training layer. [ARCH: Layer 10]
- This section blocks clinical, device, deployment, rehabilitation, real-body-control, real patient-safety, or real stimulation-control claims. [ARCH: Layer 0]

##### 5.1 Minimal, target, and stretch execution modes

| Mode | Status in Phase 12 | Required outputs | Claim boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| E0 — no embodiment | fallback/minimum preservation mode | absence/skip manifest or `NegativeResultNote`; no state/outcome records | earlier thesis evidence remains; no action-consequence claim |
| E1 — static replay | minimum Layer 9 bridge | command timeline, safety-event log where applicable, E1 manifest, preliminary embodiment card source | command/no-command trace only; no physics/musculoskeletal claim |
| E2 — MyoSuite simple task | preferred Phase 12 target | `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, endpoint-error curve, outcome summary, demo manifest | simulated proxy action-consequence only |
| E3 — MyoSuite with stress | stretch/conditional | E2 outputs plus stress-conditioned outcome table and paired clean/stress curves | simulated stress-conditioned proxy only; requires Phase 9 lineage |
| E4 — OpenSim replay/visualization | Phase 13-owned optional branch | not produced as Phase 12 primary evidence except optional handoff readiness/skip note | optional visualization only; no biomechanics validation |
| E5 — comparative embodiment report | A13 package readiness / may complete after Phase 13 | comparative tables, card set, manifest set, limitations | simulated comparative evidence only; final statistical packaging deferred |

#### 8. Validation gates and exit conditions

##### 8.1 Phase-entry gates

| Gate | Required pass condition | Failure status |
|---|---|---|
| Previous-phase handoff gate | Phase 0–11 playbook content available and preserved; Phase 11 handoff to Phase 12 consumed. | Block cumulative official section if absent; pass in this generation. |
| Source lineage gate | Required source/split/window/prediction/readiness/policy/stress lineage present for claimed rows. | Missing lineage blocks or marks diagnostic-only. |
| Configuration gate | Mode, branch, seed, command mapping, safety rules, logging schema, and manifest stub declared before outcomes. | Missing command/logging config blocks claim-facing execution. |
| Command vocabulary gate | Source IHARQ and policy actions are canonical/source-supported and map to allowed command/hold/fallback/block states. | Unsupported mapping fails closed; affected comparator diagnostic-only. |
| Leakage gate | Evaluation-only labels, correctness helpers, future rewards/states/outcomes are excluded from decision-time command selection and frozen evaluation. | Leakage blocks or invalidates affected runs. |

##### 8.2 Internal checkpoints

| Checkpoint | Required evidence | Failure behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Safety-gate checkpoint | Every command route has a pre-step safety-gate result and reason code. | fail closed; safe hold/no-action or blocked run with safety note. |
| E1 checkpoint | Every readiness state maps to a logged command/no-command timeline. | Phase 12 diagnostic-only if no command timeline can be produced. |
| E2 MyoSuite checkpoint | Reset/step/logging produce finite reproducible state and complete records. | fall back to E1/E0; record MyoSuite failure as negative result. |
| E3 stress checkpoint | Each stress-conditioned run has validated `StressProfileRecord`, `StressScheduleRecord`, and paired clean baseline. | remove stress claim; retain E2 if valid. |
| Logging checkpoint | `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, safety/logs, source links, hashes, and manifest references are complete. | affected run invalid or diagnostic-only. |
| Reward/update checkpoint | Reward config and `Layer9RewardTrace` present if reward feedback claimed; `PolicyUpdateTrace` present for policy updates. | reward/adaptive claims diagnostic-only. |
| Metric dictionary checkpoint | Claim-facing metric IDs have definitions/references. | affected metrics diagnostic-only. |
| Matched comparison checkpoint | A13 comparator rows share required source/mapping/simulator/policy/stress keys. | unmatched rows excluded or diagnostic-only, not silently aggregated. |
| Layer 10 checkpoint | Dashboard/card/reproducibility sources link to saved records and manifests. | dashboard can show warning only; no thesis-ready export. |
| Layer 0 checkpoint | Limitation tags and forbidden-claim checks pass. | claim-facing use blocked until corrected. |

##### 8.3 Exit conditions

Phase 12 may exit as:

| Exit status | Condition | Downstream use |
|---|---|---|
| `pass_with_stretch_outputs` | E2 and/or E3 records validate, manifest complete, A13 evaluation artifacts prepared, Layer 10/Layer 0 handoffs complete. | Phase 13 optional replay, Phase 14 dashboard, Phase 15 thesis integration may consume validation-status-aware outputs. |
| `pass_with_E1_fallback` | Static replay and command timeline validate, but MyoSuite E2/E3 is unavailable or invalid. | Enables limited command/no-command trace and dashboard warning; no endpoint/physics claim. |
| `diagnostic_only` | Partial records exist but key lineage, mapping, metric, manifest, simulator, or matched keys fail. | Inspectable by Layer 10 and Layer 0 but not claim-ready. |
| `blocked` | Required source records/configs/logging are absent, unsafe leakage exists, or handoff metadata cannot be created. | Downstream phases cannot use affected evidence until repaired or re-run. |
| `optional_stretch_not_run` | E0 absence is declared and manifested. | Earlier thesis validity preserved; A13 action-consequence claims absent. |

#### 9. Matched-comparison key preservation

| Key family | Phase 12 requirement | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| Source/data keys | dataset ID, subject ID, session/run ID, trial/window ID through `WindowRecord`, split ID, split role, preprocessing ID, label-map ID | all Phase 12 rows |
| Decoder/calibration keys | model ID, decoder ID, model family, class order, score type, calibration ID, uncertainty ID, threshold ID where used | A0–A4/A13 comparator lineage |
| Readiness/evidence keys | IHARQ decision ID, evidence-quality ID, fallback/unsafe/evidence-request IDs, reason codes, canonical source action token | A5–A7/A13 readiness routes |
| Policy/deferral keys | readiness context ID, policy ID, policy family, action-space version, legality-mask ID, deferral target/reason, cost/reward config ID, frozen/update mode, `PolicyUpdateTrace` ID where needed | A8–A11/A13 routes |
| Simulation keys | transition ID, closed-loop session ID, rollout ID, episode ID, reward trace ID, environment config ID, safety-event ID where materialized | closed-loop-conditioned Phase 12 |
| Stress keys | stress profile ID, stress schedule ID, stress family/intensity/schedule, clean/stressed pairing ID, stress injection point, stress seed/config | E3 and A12/A13 stress-conditioned comparisons |
| Embodiment keys | embodiment run ID, embodiment mode E0–E5, simulator branch/version, simulator config ID, command mapping ID, safety-rules ID, logging schema ID, `EmbodimentStateRecord` ID, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord` ID, command-timeline ID, endpoint-curve ID, manifest ID | all Layer 9 outputs |
| Evaluation keys | global ablation ID A13, local mode slice ID, matched-comparison key, metric dictionary ID, evaluation mode label, diagnostic-only status, negative-result note ID, claim-evidence ID, dashboard/export ID | evaluation/dashboard/thesis handoff |
| Reproducibility keys | run ID, seed, config hash, source record IDs, schema version, record version, file hash/checksum where available | all outputs |

A missing key must not be silently imputed. If the key is mandatory for a claim-facing comparison, the affected comparison is blocked or diagnostic-only. If the key is optional or branch-specific, the affected branch is omitted with an explicit missingness or negative-result note. [EVAL: A13 matched keys] [FRAME: matched-key audit]

#### 10. Ablation and evaluation obligations

##### 10.1 Direct, prepared, consumed, and preserved ablations

| Ablation ID | Phase 12 obligation | Status |
|---|---|---|
| A0 — raw decoder baseline | May provide accept-all/raw-command comparator only after Layer 9 mapping and embodiment records exist. | consumed/preserved comparator lineage |
| A1 — calibrated decoder baseline | May provide calibrated-confidence comparator context where calibration records validate. | consumed/preserved comparator lineage |
| A2 — simple registered threshold / confidence-threshold baseline | May provide threshold/no-command comparator under registered threshold lineage. | consumed/preserved comparator lineage |
| A3 — uncertainty and selective prediction | May provide selective/no-action/request comparator context where uncertainty/selective records validate. | consumed/preserved comparator lineage |
| A4 — longer-window, multi-window voting/averaging, and ordinary ensemble controls | May provide ordinary-control comparator where matched A4 outputs exist. | consumed/preserved comparator lineage |
| A5 — IHARQ-lite | Provides readiness-gated command behavior through canonical IHARQ decisions. | consumed as key upstream comparator |
| A6 — IHARQ + evidence-quality estimator | Provides evidence-quality context where valid; Phase 12 does not produce A6. | consumed/conditional |
| A7 — IHARQ + RegimeRisk | Provides regime/trust/stop-loss context where valid; no clinical fatigue/safety claim. | consumed/conditional |
| A8 — learning-to-defer | Provides deferral/no-action/fallback comparator and burden context. | consumed/conditional |
| A9 — supervised Adaptive-IHARQ | Provides frozen supervised policy-action comparator where valid. | consumed/conditional |
| A10 — contextual bandit | Provides update-enabled/frozen policy comparator only with trace/no-mutation governance. | consumed/conditional |
| A11 — RL policy | Provides sequential policy comparator only with validated or diagnostic Phase 11 outputs. | consumed/conditional |
| A12 — stress tests | Provides clean/stressed context for E3 stress-conditioned embodiment; Phase 12 does not produce A12. | consumed/conditional |
| A13 — MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay embodiment demonstration | Phase 12 directly produces the MyoSuite/static-replay portion of A13 source evidence and prepares Phase 13 optional OpenSim continuation. | directly enabled/produced in source-record terms |

A0–A13 remain evaluation-use identifiers, not implementation phases or record owners. Phase 12 owns Layer 9 records because the Execution Plan and Architecture assign Layer 9/Phase 12 responsibility, not because A13 itself produces records. [EVAL: A13 identity] [FRAME: ablations are comparisons]

##### 10.2 Required A13 metric families

Phase 12 must prepare Layer 10/export-ready metric references for command success/failure, endpoint error where E2/E3 exists, blocked-command/safe-hold/no-action/fallback burden, unsafe-event proxy rate, delay cost, over/under-assist, smoothness or instability proxy where supported, stress sensitivity where E3 exists, optional reward/cost decomposition where `Layer9RewardTrace` is enabled, completeness/missingness, and reproducibility/manifest completeness. Metric formulas, units, denominators, final statistical tests, and final run matrices remain deferred where not explicitly defined in the current sources. [EVAL: A13 metrics] [FRAME: final experiment protocol boundary]

##### 10.3 Diagnostic-only and negative-result interpretation

Phase 12 must preserve negative, null, failed, skipped, or degraded outcomes. MyoSuite unavailability, unsupported command mappings, E2 simulator instability, E3 stress collapse, simple baselines outperforming readiness/policy methods, excessive hold/fallback burden, missing manifests, missing metric definitions, or OpenSim absence must be recorded using `NegativeResultNote`, `DiagnosticOnlyFlag`, manifest warnings, and Layer 10/Layer 0 limitation metadata rather than hidden. [EVAL: negative-result discipline]

[ARCH: Layer 10]

#### 12. Claim-safety and limitation boundaries

##### 12.1 Allowed claim level

After successful Phase 12 execution, Layer 0 may allow only bounded statements such as:

- the system connected readiness-gated public-data neural-intent evidence to simulated proxy command consequences through declared mappings;
- static replay or MyoSuite simple-task records were generated with traceable source lineage and limitation tags;
- readiness, deferral, policy, or stress conditions changed simulated command burden, endpoint proxy outcomes, safety-event proxy rates, delay, fallback, or blocked-action rates, if matched comparisons validate;
- Phase 12 evidence is public-data-grounded, offline, simulated, proxy-only, non-clinical, and limited by the declared simulator/mapping assumptions.

[ARCH: Layer 0] [EVAL: A13 allowed wording]

##### 12.2 Forbidden claim classes

Phase 12 must not claim or imply:

- clinical validation;
- real patient safety;
- real muscle stimulation control;
- real BCI-FES, exoskeleton, implanted-interface, or medical-device readiness;
- rehabilitation efficacy;
- therapeutic benefit;
- real-time deployed assistive control;
- subject-specific biomechanics validation;
- real fatigue/drift/pathology diagnosis;
- MyoSuite/OpenSim proof of real-body control;
- dashboard visualization as proof of embodied control.

[ARCH: Layer 9 non-scope] [EVAL: A13 forbidden wording]

##### 12.3 Required limitation tags

Every Phase 12 record or export-facing artifact must carry applicable tags from this set where supported by the source schemas/manifests: `public_data_only`, `offline_evaluation_only`, `simulation_only`, `embodiment_proxy_only`, `static_replay_only` where E1, `MyoSuite_proxy_task_only` where E2/E3, `synthetic_stress_only` where E3, `OpenSim_optional_nonclinical` where relevant for Phase 13 handoff, `not_clinical_validation`, `not_real_patient_safety`, `not_real_muscle_control`, `not_medical_device_validation`, `not_rehabilitation_efficacy`, `not_deployment_ready`, `diagnostic_only` where applicable, and `stretch_only` for C4 branch outputs. [DERIVED from ARCH+REG+EVAL]

##### 12.4 Evidence required before stronger claims

No stronger real-world, clinical, safety, device, rehabilitation, or real muscle-control claim is allowed without external real-world/clinical/device validation not present in the supplied documents, plus Layer 0 review and later thesis evidence-map authorization. [ARCH: Layer 0] [FRAME: paper/thesis evidence map boundary]

#### 13. Failure, missingness, and diagnostic-only handling

| Failure / missingness mode | Required handling | Layer 10 visibility | Layer 0 effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prior source/split/window lineage missing | Block affected A13 comparison or mark diagnostic-only. | missing-key warning | no command-consequence claim |
| Command mapping missing, ambiguous, unsupported, or changed post hoc | Block command-consequence claim; fail closed to hold/no-action if executed. | mapping warning | claim blocked |
| Evaluation-only label or future outcome leakage | Invalidate affected rows/runs; preserve leakage note. | leakage warning | claim blocked |
| MyoSuite unavailable/import failure | Fall back to E0/E1; produce `NegativeResultNote` and manifest/skip note. | MyoSuite-unavailable panel | no E2/E3 claim |
| MyoSuite reset/step finite-state failure | Mark E2/E3 invalid; preserve simulator error and artifacts where safe. | simulator error warning | no physics-backed action-consequence claim |
| E1 command timeline missing | Phase 12 diagnostic-only or blocked because minimum Layer 9 bridge failed. | command-timeline missing warning | no Layer 9 command claim |
| E3 stress lineage or clean/stressed pairing missing | Remove stress-conditioned claim; continue E1/E2 if valid. | stress lineage warning | no stress-conditioned claim |
| `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest` missing | All thesis-facing A13 evidence diagnostic-only. | manifest warning | reproducibility/claim readiness blocked |
| Safety-event log/record linkage missing where safety rates claimed | Block safety-event rate claims; mark affected rows diagnostic-only. | safety-event warning | no patient-safety claim regardless |
| Metric dictionary entry missing | Keep metric diagnostic-only; do not export claim-facing metric. | metric warning | metric claim blocked |
| `Layer9RewardTrace` missing when reward feedback claimed | Downgrade reward/policy-feedback claims; continue non-reward A13 if valid. | reward trace warning | no adaptive/reward claim |
| `PolicyUpdateTrace` missing for update-enabled policy-conditioned A13 | Downgrade adaptive/bandit/RL-conditioned A13 to diagnostic-only. | update-trace warning | no update-enabled claim |
| Frozen evaluation lacks no-mutation audit | Downgrade frozen comparisons; preserve run. | frozen/update warning | comparison claim blocked |
| Negative/null/simple-baseline-better results | Preserve in `NegativeResultNote`; do not omit from summaries. | negative-result panel | limits or weakens claims |
| Clinical/real-control wording appears | Block thesis-facing use until corrected. | claim-safety warning | Layer 0 rejection |

`NegativeResultNote` and `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` must be source-linked, scope-specific, and visible to Layer 10 and Layer 0. They are not failures of documentation; they are part of the evidence-control system. [EVAL: negative-result discipline] [REG: diagnostic artifacts]

[REG: `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest`] [ARCH: L9.1/L9.13]

#### 17. Definition of done

Phase 12 is complete for actual execution only when all applicable items below are satisfied or explicitly downgraded:

| Definition-of-done item | Required status |
|---|---|
| Required upstream records validated | pass, diagnostic-only, or blocked with visible reason |
| Layer 9 mode selected | E0/E1/E2/E3 declared before outcome inspection |
| Configuration snapshot created | run ID, seed, command mapping, safety rules, logging schema, simulator branch/version, and hashes recorded |
| Leakage guard passed | no evaluation-only labels/future outcomes in decision-time command selection |
| Safety gate applied | every command route passes through readiness safety gate before simulator step |
| Command mapping validated | unsupported labels/actions fail closed or are diagnostic-only |
| E1 static replay output produced if used | command timeline and manifest complete |
| E2 MyoSuite output produced if claimed | state/outcome records, endpoint curve, finite-state checks, and manifest complete |
| E3 stress output produced if claimed | Phase 9 stress records and clean/stressed pairing valid |
| Logging complete | `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, safety logs, source IDs, file hashes/checksums, diagnostic flags complete |
| Reward/update controls passed where applicable | `Layer9RewardTrace`, reward config, `PolicyUpdateTrace`, and frozen/no-mutation audit present as required |
| A13 evaluation artifacts prepared | `EvaluationOutcomeRecord`, `MatchedComparisonReport`, metric dictionary refs, negative/diagnostic notes present |
| Matched-comparison keys preserved | all required keys present or missing-key diagnostic reasons recorded |
| Layer 10 handoff created | dashboard/card/reproducibility source bundle prepared with limitations |
| Layer 0 handoff created | allowed/forbidden claim boundaries and limitation tags attached |
| Failures preserved | negative/null/skipped/failed outcomes recorded and visible |
| Open issues carried forward | unresolved registry/evaluation/build/paper issues listed |
| No unacknowledged canonical-name mismatch remains | pass or explicit requires-confirmation item |

At playbook-generation time, the Phase 12 section itself is complete for review, while actual Phase 12 empirical execution remains pending.

#### 0B. Completeness and undefined-item control

This final revision treats “undefined” as an explicit status to be managed, not as an acceptable blank. For Phase 13, a playbook element is considered sufficiently defined only when it has: source-grounded status, owner/producer or consumer, validation requirement, failure or downgrade consequence, Layer 0 claim-safety effect where relevant, and Layer 10/export visibility where relevant. `[FRAME: gap and confirmation audit]` `[FRAME: domain non-interference]`

| Item category | Required Phase 13 handling | Forbidden handling |
|---|---|---|
| Canonical phase/layer/module/ablation/record names | Use only supplied official names. | Inventing a new official phase, layer, module, ablation ID, metric, schema, path, or record. |
| Source-supported but not schema-final OpenSim items | Classify as architecture-/registry-supported optional artifact families or procedural controls, then attach `requires_registry_confirmation` or a more precise deferred status. | Silently treating them as finalized canonical records. |
| Missing execution-time evidence | Classify as `diagnostic_only`, `skipped_non_blocking`, `future_work_only`, `not_applicable`, or `blocked` according to validation gates. | Leaving an item as “TBD” or using it in thesis/export claims without a status. |
| Future-document responsibilities | Defer to the proper document domain: Nuts-and-Bolts for internals, Build Book for paths/commands/tests, final evaluation protocol for run matrix/statistics/metric formulas, Paper/Thesis Evidence Map for final placement and wording. | Filling those details inside the Phase Execution Playbook. |
| Actual Phase 13 execution artifacts | Require source IDs, manifest linkage, limitation tags, validation status, diagnostic/future-work status, and downstream handoff fields. | Hiding failed replay, skipped branch, missing lineage, missing metric definitions, missing tool anchors, or missing limitations. |

Therefore, the open issues in Section 16 and the YAML `open_issues` list are not unresolved prose gaps; they are explicit governance statuses that prevent unsupported canonization or overclaiming until the relevant future authority resolves them.

Phase 13 begins by treating all accepted Phase 0–12 records and phase text as immutable. It consumes only validation-status-aware handoff artifacts; it may derive replay artifacts, diagnostic flags, comparison reports, or skip notes, but it may not overwrite upstream source records. `[FRAME: immutable record discipline]` `[PRIOR: Phase 12 handoff]`

| Phase 1 | Dataset, subject/session, window/trial, split, preprocessing, label-map, artifact flags | Preserve source lineage through Phase 12 command trajectories. | Comparison diagnostic-only or blocked. |

| Phase 4 | `IHARQDecisionRecord`, evidence/fallback/unsafe-event lineage | Preserve canonical action-token semantics and mapping to commands. | IHARQ-gated replay/comparison blocked or diagnostic-only. |
| Phase 5 | `RegimeStateRecord`, `TrustStateRecord` where present | Preserve temporal ordering, trust/regime IDs, and warning status. | Regime-aware replay comparison diagnostic-only. |
| Phase 6 | `ReadinessContextRecord`, `PolicyActionRecord`, `DeferralRecord` where used | Preserve decision-time-visible feature boundary and policy/deferral lineage. | Policy/deferral replay variant excluded or diagnostic-only. |
| Phase 7 | `TransitionRecord`, session/episode/reward/safety lineage where consumed | Preserve transition IDs, reward config/trace, and simulation-only limitation. | Sequence-level replay/comparison diagnostic-only. |

No source-grounded defect in Phase 0–12 requires a Back-Propagation Correction Request during this generation pass. Phase 13 instead carries forward unresolved issues as current-phase open issues because the source documents identify them as confirmation/deferred items rather than accepted prior-phase errors.

#### 3. Architecture-grounded phase objective

Phase 13 operationalizes the optional Layer 9 OpenSim branch after Phase 12 has already produced or declared embodiment artifacts. Its objective is to move from validated Phase 12 command/movement lineage to one of four auditable branch outcomes: `implemented_validated_optional`, `implemented_diagnostic_only`, `skipped_non_blocking`, or `future_work_only`.

| Layer | Phase 13 role |
|---|---|
| Layer 0 — Claim-Safety and Scope Governance | Reviews optional OpenSim wording, limitation tags, diagnostic-only labels, overclaim risks, future-work/skip notes, and thesis/export eligibility. |
| Layers 1–5 | Provide inherited public-data, prediction, calibration, uncertainty, IHARQ, and RegimeRisk lineage through Phase 12 artifacts; not re-executed. |
| Layer 6 | Provides policy/deferral context only if selected trajectories were policy-conditioned; Phase 13 may not update policies. |
| Layer 7 | Provides transition/reward/simulation lineage only where selected replay assets depend on it; Phase 13 does not become the closed-loop environment. |
| Layer 8 | Provides stress lineage only when stress-conditioned trajectories are replayed or compared. |
| Layer 9 | Owns optional OpenSim replay/comparison source artifacts and mapping-limitation source bundle. |
| Layer 10 | Later reads saved Phase 13 artifacts/skip notes as read-only dashboard/card/export/reproducibility inputs. |

Participating modules are L9.1 for branch/run identity, L9.2 for intake validation, L9.6 for adapter boundary, L9.9 for optional OpenSim replay, L9.12 for replay log/safety linkage, and L9.13 for Phase 14-ready packaging. Exact OpenSim commands, model internals, and simulator debugging remain `deferred_to_build_book` / `deferred_to_nuts_and_bolts`.

| Layer 9 / L9.2 Record intake and validator | Validate Phase 12 trajectories, movement assets, manifests, command mappings, safety logs, limitation tags, and accepted missingness. | Consumes immutable upstream artifacts; produces validation overlays or diagnostic flags. |
| Layer 9 / L9.6 Simulator adapter interface | Preserve the boundary between readiness actions and low-level simulated motor/replay commands. | Adapter-boundary validation; exact implementation internals deferred. |
| Layer 9 / L9.9 OpenSim replay adapter | Attempt or explicitly skip optional OpenSim replay/visualization; document model/config/units/assumptions where attempted. | Optional replay logs/output manifest/visuals or skip/future-work note. |

#### 5. Execution procedure

1. **Preserve cumulative state and declare branch intent.** Consume the Phase 12 handoff and declare `attempt_replay`, `attempt_comparison`, `skip_non_blocking`, or `future_work_only`, plus whether OpenSim is active-use, documentation-only, omitted, attempted-but-failed, or future-work-only. Missing branch status blocks Phase 14/15 use. `[DERIVED from ARCH+EXEC+PRIOR]`

2. **Validate Phase 12 replay-source package.** Check selected command timelines, movement assets, endpoint/outcome summaries, `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest`, command mapping, safety-event mapping, diagnostic flags, and limitation tags. Do not edit Phase 12 artifacts. Missing compatible assets route to skip/future-work; invalid lineage makes replay diagnostic-only. `[PRIOR: Phase 12 handoff]`

3. **Validate OpenSim configuration and tool-anchor status when attempted.** Check OpenSim model/replay asset pointer, units/movement assumptions, deterministic setting/seed, config hash, and tool/version/license/access note where available. Missing reproducibility anchors downgrade the implemented branch to diagnostic-only or skip/future-work. `[ARCH: L9.9 reproducibility]` `[REG: ROI-ANCHOR-001]`

4. **Validate mapping limitations and Layer 0 tags before replay.** Attach strict limitation tags and non-clinical/non-biomechanical wording to every replay/log/plot/report/source-bundle. Missing mapping limitation text blocks thesis/export use. `[REG: embodiment limitation tags]`

5. **Execute optional replay at evidence-control level.** Replay selected trajectories or simplified movement profiles only from validated sources. Produce OpenSim output manifest, replay logs, screenshots/plots if generated, and `NegativeResultNote` if failed/unstable/unhelpful. Exact OpenSim commands, setup steps, model internals, and file paths are deferred. `[ARCH: L9.9 OpenSim replay adapter]`

6. **Validate optional comparison only if `A13.E5` is attempted.** Identify implemented, absent, skipped, and diagnostic-only `A13.E0`–`A13.E4` local mode slices; compare only matched rows with metric dictionary entries, branch-status labels, manifest links, limitation tags, and negative-result notes. Produce an optional comparison report governed by `MatchedComparisonReport`, with metric references and diagnostic-only flags where required. Missing metric definitions, missing source manifests, unmatched rows, or missing limitation tags make the comparison diagnostic-only. `[EVAL: A13.E5 comparative embodiment report]`

7. **Preserve frozen/update and stress-conditioned separation.** If replay consumes Phase 10/11 policy actions, separate frozen and update-enabled evidence with `PolicyUpdateTrace`/disabled-update audit. If replay is stress-conditioned, preserve `StressProfileRecord`, `StressScheduleRecord`, stress seed, and clean/stress pairing. Mixed evidence becomes diagnostic-only. `[EVAL: A10/A11/A12/A13]`

8. **Package Layer 10-ready source materials.** Separate dashboard-readable source artifacts, dashboard-warning inputs, Layer 10-derived outputs to be generated later, and not-dashboard implementation-local material. Layer 10 may read only saved artifacts and warnings. `[ARCH: Layer 10 read-only evidence]`

9. **Produce skip/future-work closure when OpenSim is not implemented.** Create a skip/future-work note with reason, branch status, non-blocking thesis effect, limitation tags, and downstream handling. If skip follows a failed attempt, create `NegativeResultNote`. Hidden skip status blocks downstream use. `[EXEC: Phase 13 exit condition]`

10. **Finalize Layer 0 review and downstream handoff.** Classify outputs as optional validated, diagnostic-only, skipped, or future-work-only; attach limitation tags; preserve open issues; prepare Phase 14/15/Layer 0/Layer 10 handoff. Any unresolved claim-safety violation blocks thesis-facing use.

#### 6. Output contract

Outputs are classified conservatively. `MatchedComparisonReport`, `MetricDictionaryEntry`, `MetricDictionary`, `NegativeResultNote`, `DiagnosticOnlyFlag`, `CardRecord`, `ReproducibilityManifest`, `EmbodimentStateRecord`, `EmbodimentOutcomeRecord`, `SafetyEventRecord`, `Layer9RewardTrace`, and `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest` are registry-grounded names. Branch status, replay logs, screenshots/plots, OpenSim output manifests, replay limitations statements, and skip/future-work notes are source-supported output families or procedural artifacts unless and until the registry finalizes exact schemas/paths. `[REG: evaluation artifacts]` `[REG: Layer 9 OpenSim optional artifacts]`

Claim-readiness rule: no Phase 13 output is claim-ready merely because it exists. It is eligible for bounded optional claim use only if branch status, source lineage, manifest/config hash, limitation tags, metric dictionary entries where needed, matched keys where needed, diagnostic/negative-result status, Layer 10 source-readiness metadata, and Layer 0 review are all present.
