#### 8. Validation gates and exit conditions

| Gate | Requirement | Pass status permits | Diagnostic-only / blocked status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gate A — Branch-status declaration | Declare one of `implemented_validated_optional`, `implemented_diagnostic_only`, `skipped_non_blocking`, or `future_work_only`, plus active-use/documentation-only/omitted/failed status. `[EXEC: Phase 13 exit status]` | Downstream can interpret Phase 13 optional status. | Missing status blocks Phase 14/15 use. |
| Gate B — Phase 12 source-lineage validation | Selected command timelines/movement assets, command mapping, safety status, simulator metadata, limitations, and `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest` must be present or accepted-missing. | Replay may proceed or skip is justified. | Missing lineage ⇒ diagnostic-only or skip/future-work. |
| Gate C — OpenSim config/reproducibility validation | If attempted, manifest must include config hash, model/replay asset pointer, units/assumptions, seed/deterministic note, and tool/version/license/access note where available. | Optional replay can be dashboard/export-readable. | Missing reproducibility ⇒ diagnostic-only. |
| Gate D — Mapping and claim-safety validation | Mapping limitation text and Layer 0 tags must be attached to every output, figure, card source, report, and skip note. | Bounded optional visualization can proceed. | Missing warnings block thesis/export use. |
| Gate E — Optional comparison validity | If E5 or quantitative comparison is attempted, `MatchedComparisonReport` and `MetricDictionaryEntry` coverage must exist or missingness must be explicit. | Bounded optional comparison can be prepared. | Unmatched/undefined metrics ⇒ diagnostic-only. |
| Gate F — Frozen/update and stress-pair separation | Policy-conditioned replay must separate frozen from update-enabled traces; stress-conditioned replay must preserve clean/stress pairing. | A10/A11/A12-conditioned contexts remain interpretable. | Mixed/update or unmatched stress ⇒ affected branch diagnostic-only. |
| Gate G — Layer 10 source-readiness | Saved artifacts must include source IDs, manifest pointers, warning tags, validation status, and diagnostic/future-work labels. | Phase 14 may read and display as derived views/cards/exports. | Not dashboard/export-ready. |
| Gate H — Layer 0 claim-safety closure | No forbidden clinical/biomechanical/real-control/device/deployment wording; limitation tags visible. | Optional thesis/appendix/future-work use may be considered later. | Unsupported claim wording blocks output. |

Exit conditions are: **implemented validated optional**, **implemented diagnostic-only**, **skipped non-blocking**, or **future-work-only**. Any of these can be a valid Phase 13 phase-exit state if the corresponding notes, tags, validation status, and handoff entries are complete.

#### 9. Matched-comparison key preservation

Matched comparison is required only if Phase 13 attempts A13.E5 comparative reporting or a quantitative/semi-quantitative optional comparison. Qualitative replay-only E4 may mark comparison keys not applicable with a reason, but still requires source lineage.

| Key family | Required keys / references where applicable | Missing-key consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Source/protocol | `dataset_id`, `subject_id`, `session_id`, `run_id`, `trial_id` or `parent_trial_id`, `window_id`, `split_id`, `split_role`, `preprocessing_id`, `label_map_id`, artifact flags | Comparison diagnostic-only or blocked. |
| Decoder/model | `PredictionRecord` ID, `model_id`, `decoder_id`, model family, seed, config hash | Cannot attribute replay to matched decoder context. |
| Calibration/uncertainty/threshold | calibration ID, uncertainty ID, selective-prediction ID, threshold registry ID | A1/A2/A3-linked replay comparison diagnostic-only. |
| IHARQ/evidence | `IHARQDecisionRecord` ID, action token, reason code, evidence/fallback/unsafe/request/wait links | IHARQ-gated comparison blocked. |
| Regime/trust | `RegimeStateRecord` ID, `TrustStateRecord` ID where present, stop-loss/warning status | A7-context comparison diagnostic-only. |
| Policy/deferral | `PolicyActionRecord` ID, `DeferralRecord` ID, policy ID/version, cost/reward config, frozen/update mode | Policy-conditioned replay diagnostic-only. |
| Update governance | `PolicyUpdateTrace` ID where update-enabled; disabled-update audit for frozen evaluation | Mixed evidence diagnostic-only. |
| Simulation/transition | `TransitionRecord` ID, episode/session/rollout IDs, environment diagnostic status, reward trace ID where used | Qualitative-only or diagnostic-only. |
| Stress | `StressProfileRecord`, `StressScheduleRecord`, stress seed, clean/stressed pair ID, injection point | A12-conditioned branch diagnostic-only. |
| Embodiment | embodiment mode ID/E0–E5, command mapping ID/hash, safety rules ID, simulator branch/config hash, endpoint/outcome IDs | A13.E4/E5 incomplete. |
| OpenSim | OpenSim config ID/hash, model/replay asset ID, movement-profile config, units, deterministic setting/seed, tool/version/license/access note where available | Implemented branch diagnostic-only if absent. |
| Evaluation/reporting | metric dictionary ID, matched comparison report ID, negative-result note ID, diagnostic-only flag ID, claim-evidence link, dashboard/export ID | Claim/evaluation handoff blocked or diagnostic-only. |

#### 10. Ablation and evaluation obligations

Phase 13 does not define ablations and does not own A13 artifacts. It produces or conditions optional evidence that may be evaluated under A13 if the official evaluation protocol requirements are satisfied. `[EVAL: A13 identity lock]`

| Ablation / evaluation context | Phase 13 relationship | Required preservation / output | Diagnostic-only trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| A0 | Inherited comparator lineage if accept-all/raw-command mapping is included. | Preserve prediction/model/source keys and command mapping. | Missing mapping or source lineage. |
| A1–A4 | Inherited calibration/threshold/selective/ordinary-control lineage where Phase 12 assets include those variants. | Preserve operating point, threshold, uncertainty/selective, ordinary-control keys. | Unmatched or incomplete lineage. |
| A5 | Consumed where IHARQ-gated commands are replayed/compared. | Preserve `IHARQDecisionRecord` action/reason/fallback/unsafe lineage. | Invalid action-token or command mapping. |
| A6–A9 | Consumed where evidence-quality/supervised policy/deferral contexts feed selected trajectories. | Preserve decision-time-visible and leakage-safe policy context. | Missing policy/deferral/evidence-quality lineage. |
| A10/A11 | Consumed where contextual-bandit/RL outputs are replayed. | Preserve frozen/update separation, `PolicyUpdateTrace`, reward config, held-out evaluation status. | Mixed frozen/update or missing update trace. |
| A12 | Consumed where stress-conditioned trajectories are replayed or compared. | Preserve stress profile/schedule IDs, stress seed, clean/stress pairing. | Missing stress lineage or unmatched pair. |
| A13.E4 | Directly enabled when OpenSim replay/visualization is implemented. | OpenSim output manifest, replay logs, screenshots/plots where generated, mapping-limitation source bundle. | Missing OpenSim config/tool/source/manifest/limitation data. |
| A13.E5 | Conditionally enabled when E0–E4 outputs are matched and metric entries exist. | Optional comparison report, `MatchedComparisonReport`, `MetricDictionaryEntry`, `NegativeResultNote`, diagnostic flags, claim-evidence linkage. | Missing matched keys, metrics, mode status, or Layer 0 review. |

Metrics / metric families Phase 13 must prepare only where comparison is attempted: command success/failure proxy metrics; endpoint error proxy metrics where source fields exist; blocked/safe-hold/no-action/fallback/delay burden metrics; simulated safety-event proxy rates where event lineage exists; stress sensitivity where A12 lineage exists; reward/cost terms where `Layer9RewardTrace` or compatible reward trace exists; manifest/reproducibility completeness and diagnostic-only status. Exact formulas, units, denominators, statistical tests, seed grids, and final run matrix remain `deferred_to_final_experiment_protocol`.

#### 11. Dashboard, card, and reproducibility obligations

Layer 10 is a read-only audit/reproducibility consumer for Phase 13. It may render saved artifacts; it must not recompute replay, retune mappings, edit source visuals to hide failures, repair missing lineage, remove diagnostic labels, or promote optional OpenSim into core thesis evidence. `[ARCH: Layer 10]` `[EXEC: Phase 14 handoff]`

| Layer 10 need | Phase 13 handoff requirement |
|---|---|
| Dashboard visibility | Branch status, optionality, implemented/skipped/future-work/diagnostic state, OpenSim active-use/documentation-only/omitted status. |
| Cards | Mapping-limitation source bundle and warning inputs for later `EmbodimentCard`/`CardRecord` rendering. |
| Metrics | Metric dictionary IDs/entries where quantitative comparison is attempted; otherwise metrics not-applicable reason. |
| Matched comparison reports | `MatchedComparisonReport` or diagnostic comparison note where E5 is attempted. |
| Static figures/tables | Manifest-linked screenshots/plots/replay logs if generated; final numbering and thesis placement `deferred_to_paper_evidence_map`. |
| Artifact lineage | Source record IDs, run IDs, command mapping IDs, OpenSim config hash, replay asset ID, units/assumptions, seed/deterministic setting, branch status, limitation tags, validation status. |
| Reproducibility manifests | OpenSim output manifest where attempted; skip/future-work note where omitted; source artifact checksums/hashes where available. |
| Export readiness | Explicit flags: dashboard-readable source artifact, dashboard-warning input, Layer 10-derived output later, or not-dashboard implementation-local material. |
| Auditability | Negative results, diagnostic-only flags, accepted missingness, unresolved tool-anchor/schema/path issues, and claim-safety warnings remain visible. |

#### 12. Claim-safety and limitation boundaries

Layer 0 allowed claim level after Phase 13:

- optional, public-data-grounded, offline/proxy/simulation-only OpenSim-style replay or visualization of selected readiness-gated command trajectories;
- optional bounded statement that a replay/comparison package exists and is manifest-linked;
- optional statement that OpenSim was skipped or left future-work-only without invalidating prior evidence;
- optional A13.E4/E5 support only where matched lineage, metrics, manifests, and limitation tags validate.

Forbidden overclaims: clinical BCI-FES validation; real patient safety; medical-device readiness; real rehabilitation efficacy or therapeutic benefit; real muscle stimulation control; real assistive-control deployment/safety; direct EEG-to-muscle activation; patient-specific OpenSim biomechanics validation; proof that replayed trajectories are clinically safe, physiologically accurate, or therapeutically effective; and any implication that OpenSim completion is required for core thesis validity.

Required limitation tags:

```text
public_eeg_only
low_calibration_protocol
proxy_readiness
pseudo_label_based
evaluation_only
simulation_only
embodiment_proxy_only
MyoSuite_OpenSim_demo_only
not_clinical_validation
not_real_patient_safety
not_medical_device_readiness
not_real_rehabilitation_efficacy
not_real_muscle_stimulation_control
not_deployment_readiness
```

Conditional tags: `stress_conditioned` if stress-conditioned trajectories are replayed; `diagnostic_only` if lineage, config, metrics, matched keys, or claim-safety checks fail; `future_work_only` if OpenSim is skipped, documentation-only, or not part of the current evidence package.

#### 13. Failure, missingness, and diagnostic-only handling

| Failure / missingness mode | Required Phase 13 handling | Layer 10 visibility | Layer 0 effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| No compatible Phase 12 command trajectory or movement asset | Complete as `skipped_non_blocking` or `future_work_only`; record reason. | Show skip/future-work status only. | No OpenSim claim; prior evidence unaffected. |
| OpenSim unavailable, not installed, or unsupported | Produce skip/future-work note; optionally `NegativeResultNote` if attempt failed. | Warning/note visible. | Non-blocking; no OpenSim evidence claim. |
| Missing OpenSim config/model/replay asset/units | Skip or diagnostic-only; no validated replay claim. | Config/tool-anchor warning. | Export/thesis use downgraded. |
| Missing mapping limitation text | Block thesis/export use until repaired or mark diagnostic-only. | Limitation warning. | Strong claims blocked. |
| Invalid command mapping or unsupported aggressive command | Block replay or convert to safe-hold/no-action only if source mapping supports it; record limitation. | Mapping warning. | No action-consequence claim for invalid branch. |
| Missing output manifest or config hash | Implemented branch diagnostic-only and not export-ready. | Manifest completeness warning. | Reproducibility claim blocked. |
| Screenshots/plots manually edited without raw manifest link | Do not use as source evidence; keep raw linked version or mark diagnostic-only. | Visual provenance warning. | Figure/table claim blocked. |
| Missing metric dictionary | Comparison diagnostic-only; qualitative replay may continue. | Metric warning. | Quantitative claim blocked. |
| Unmatched E0–E4 comparison | Retain as diagnostic comparison; do not delete unmatched rows. | Diagnostic comparison warning. | E5 claim blocked. |
| Mixed frozen/update policy evidence | Separate outputs or mark affected policy-conditioned replay diagnostic-only. | Policy-update warning. | Adaptive-policy-conditioned claim blocked. |
| Missing clean/stress pairing | Stress-conditioned comparison diagnostic-only. | Stress-pair warning. | Stress-conditioned claim blocked. |
| Hidden failed replay or skipped branch | Create `NegativeResultNote`; hidden failure blocks downstream use. | Negative-result index. | Claim-safety review blocks output. |
| Clinical/biomechanical/real-control wording | Remove from thesis-facing output or block it; preserve as claim-safety failure if discovered. | Overclaim warning. | Layer 0 blocks output. |

Back-Propagation Correction Request handling: a BPCR is required only if Phase 13 discovers that an accepted prior-phase artifact is inconsistent, invalid, or insufficient in a way that should have been resolved upstream and is not already covered by an explicit open issue or accepted missingness. #### 13A. Back-Propagation Correction Request handling

No Back-Propagation Correction Request is opened by this revision because the observed issues are already represented in the supplied source documents or Phase 12 open issues as unresolved registry, implementation-detail, evaluation-protocol, dashboard/export, or paper-evidence-map items. Phase 13 must open a BPCR during actual execution only if it discovers that a validated Phase 12-or-earlier artifact is inconsistent, invalid, stale, lineage-broken, or claim-unsafe in a way that cannot be handled by a current-phase diagnostic-only flag, skip/future-work note, exclusion, or visible open issue. `[FRAME: BPCR discipline]` `[PRIOR: Phase 12 open issues]`

BPCR creation is required, rather than silent repair, if any of the following are discovered during actual Phase 13 execution:

- a Phase 12 `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest` points to missing or incompatible source assets;
- a Phase 12 command timeline, movement asset, safety log, or endpoint summary lacks the source IDs needed for the selected replay/comparison;
- Phase 12 limitation tags or claim-safety warnings are absent from artifacts intended for Phase 13 thesis-facing use;
- a previously accepted matched-comparison report is found to contain unmatched or leakage-contaminated rows;
- an accepted prior output uses clinical, real-control, real patient-safety, medical-device, rehabilitation, or subject-specific biomechanics wording contrary to Layer 0 boundaries.

The BPCR template in Section 13 remains the required structure for such a request. Until resolved, the affected Phase 13 branch is blocked or diagnostic-only according to the severity declared in the BPCR.

#### 14. Repository, storage, and reproducibility expectations

Phase 13 must use existing Layer 9 embodiment, report, figure/screenshot, metric, negative-result, claim-evidence, card/source-bundle, and manifest storage families where grounded. It must not invent exact repository paths, filenames, CLI commands, dashboard routes, or test names. Exact OpenSim-specific paths and commands remain `deferred_to_build_book` or `requires_registry_confirmation`. `[FRAME: Implementation Build Book boundary]` `[REG: repository/path open issues]`

Every stored Phase 13 output must include or explicitly mark not-applicable: `source_record_ids`, `run_id`, `phase_id`, `producer_module`, `schema_version`, `validation_status`, `config_hash`, seed or deterministic replay setting, OpenSim config ID/hash or equivalent optional branch identifier, model/replay asset pointer where attempted, units/movement-profile assumptions where attempted, command mapping ID/hash, branch status, limitation tags, diagnostic-only/future-work status, metric dictionary ID where comparison is attempted, matched-comparison report ID where comparison is attempted, negative-result note ID where relevant, Layer 10 export-readiness status, and claim-evidence entry / `ClaimEvidenceManifest` linkage where thesis-facing use is intended.

#### 15. Phase handoff package

##### 15.1 Handoff to Phase 14 — Dashboard and cards

Phase 13 hands Phase 14 either an implemented optional replay/comparison source bundle or a skip/future-work source note. If implemented, the handoff includes branch-status declaration, OpenSim output manifest, replay logs, screenshots/plots with manifest pointers if generated, optional comparison report if produced, `MatchedComparisonReport` and `MetricDictionaryEntry` references where comparison is attempted, mapping-limitation source bundle, `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest` linkage, source artifact IDs/config hashes, OpenSim tool/version/license/access note where available, negative-result notes, diagnostic-only flags, Layer 0 limitation tags, review status, and dashboard warning requirements. If skipped/future-work-only, the handoff includes skip/future-work note, reason for non-use, branch status and non-blocking thesis effect, limitation tags, and a statement that no OpenSim dashboard evidence should be displayed beyond skip/future-work/diagnostic status.

Phase 14 must not recompute OpenSim replay, fix missing artifacts silently, hide failed/skipped status, erase diagnostic-only labels, or present optional OpenSim material as core thesis evidence.

##### 15.2 Handoff to Phase 15 — Final thesis integration

Phase 13 hands Phase 15 only bounded optional material: validated visualization/screenshots/plots, optional replay logs or manifest tables, optional comparison report where matched/validated, negative-result notes, diagnostic-only flags, skip/future-work note, limitation text for every Phase 13 figure/table/paragraph, and claim-evidence entry / `ClaimEvidenceManifest` linkage with matrix/manifest alias caveat preserved.

Phase 15 may use Phase 13 only as appendix/demo/future-work material or optional C4/A13 support. It must not use Phase 13 for clinical, patient-safety, medical-device, rehabilitation, real muscle-control, patient-specific biomechanics, or deployment claims.

##### 15.3 Handoff to Layer 0 and reproducibility/export

Layer 0 receives intended Phase 13 claim wording, branch status, mapping limitations, OpenSim optionality statement, diagnostic-only/future-work labels, negative-result notes, forbidden-claim audit items, and figure/card/report/export warning coverage. The reproducibility/export handoff receives source artifact IDs and manifest links, OpenSim config hash/tool-anchor note where attempted, replay log hashes, screenshot/plot manifest entries, skip/future-work reason, validation status, limitation tags, metric/matched-comparison IDs where applicable, open issues, and diagnostic-only status.

#### 17. Definition of done

Phase 13 playbook-section completion is satisfied when the predecessor content is preserved unchanged; official phase identity is used; optional/non-blocking/stretch status is explicit; the Source Extraction Digest covers architecture, registry, execution, evaluation, prior phase, and capability facts; Phase 12 handoff assets are validated or skip/future-work pathway is defined; branch status options are declared; input/output contracts use canonical names or flagged gaps; procedure operationalizes replay/comparison/skip behavior without implementation commands; outputs are classified; upstream records remain immutable; validation gates distinguish pass/diagnostic/blocked/skipped/future-work; matched keys are preserved for E5; A0–A13 obligations are handled without A14; Layer 10 and Layer 0 handoffs are explicit; failure/missingness and negative-result handling are visible; BPCR handling is included; repository details are deferred; open issues are visible with explicit handling statuses rather than undefined placeholders; all branch-dependent entry conditions are represented; no known item remains blank or semi-defined; and the machine-readable handoff is complete.

Actual Phase 13 execution is complete only after either a validated optional replay/comparison package or an explicit skip/future-work note exists and passes the relevant Layer 0/Layer 10 handoff checks.

| Execution and Evidence Plan | Official Phase 13 identity and order are preserved; phase contract is converted into procedure rather than replaced. |
| Experiment/Ablation/Evaluation Protocol | A13 obligations are preserved; no final run matrix, statistical test, or new ablation is invented. |
| Detailed Design / Nuts-and-Bolts Specification | OpenSim replay internals, adapter algorithms, movement-profile transformations, and simulator details are deferred. |
| Implementation Build Book | Repository paths, file names, CLI commands, tests, and installation steps are not invented. |
| Paper and Thesis Evidence Map | Final claim wording, thesis section placement, figure/table numbering, and narrative are deferred. |

| Back-propagation status | No source-grounded Back-Propagation Correction Request is opened during this playbook-generation pass. Actual execution must open one if upstream source records cannot satisfy the lineage, metric, matched-comparison, warning, or claim-evidence gates defined below. |

Phase 14 is generated as the Layer 10 observability, dashboard, card, static-export, audit, and reproducibility phase. It reads and packages saved upstream records from Phases 0–13 and makes the evidence chain inspectable for Phase 15, Layer 0, supervisors, examiners, and future reproducers. It does **not** create new primary empirical evidence.

**Out of scope.** Phase 14 must not retrain decoders, recalibrate models, tune thresholds, create pseudo-labels, alter IHARQ decisions, alter RegimeRisk states, learn policies, rerun bandit/RL updates, mutate rewards, generate stress schedules, run or repair simulators, recompute hidden results, edit source records, invent missing artifacts, suppress negative results, or strengthen claim wording. `[ARCH: Layer 10 forbidden actions]` `[REG: dashboard source-vs-derived separation]`

#### 3. Architecture-grounded phase objective

Phase 14 accomplishes the architecture’s Layer 10 objective: convert validated saved records into inspectable, auditable, reproducible, claim-safe thesis artifacts. It is the final observability gate before thesis integration. `[ARCH: Layer 10 identity]` `[ARCH: Phase 14 implementation pipeline]`

| Layer | Phase 14 role | Ownership boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Layer 0 — Claim-Safety and Scope Governance | Supplies claim ledger/scope labels, warning requirements, allowed/forbidden claim boundaries, limitation tags, diagnostic-only labels, claim-evidence checks, and final review. | Audits claim wording and limitation coverage; does not create dashboard metrics or primary evidence. |
| Layer 1 — Public-Data and Protocol Anchor | Supplies dataset, window, split, preprocessing, label, artifact, card, validation, manifest, and ablation-readiness records. | Source records remain Layer 1-owned and immutable. |
| Layer 2 — Decoder and Baseline Measurement Spine | Supplies prediction, model, baseline, low-calibration, subject-profile, ordinary ensemble/control, readiness, and source cards. | Decoder evidence remains Layer 2-owned; Phase 14 renders and exports it. |
| Layer 3 — Calibration, Uncertainty, and Selective Prediction | Supplies calibration, uncertainty, selective prediction, thresholds, reliability audits, split/leakage checks, high-confidence-wrong tables, and matched operating-point artifacts. | Calibration/uncertainty evidence remains Layer 3-owned. |
| Layer 4 — IHARQ Evidence Verification | Supplies IHARQ decisions, evidence-quality variants, combined evidence, fallback, unsafe-event, ablation, trace, and evaluation outputs. | IHARQ source records remain Layer 4-owned; canonical action tokens are not rewritten. |
| Layer 5 — RegimeRisk Temporal Trust Monitoring | Supplies regime/trust state records, temporal warning context, and A7 lineage. | Temporal trust evidence remains Layer 5-owned. |
| Layer 6 — Adaptive Readiness Policy Layer | Supplies readiness context, learned evidence-quality, supervised policy actions, deferral/action records where applicable, and policy outputs. | Policy/evidence-quality records remain producer-owned; Phase 14 displays provenance and warnings. |
| Layer 7 — Simulated Closed-Loop Readiness Environment | Supplies transition, session, rollout, episode, reward, diagnostic, safety, and policy-update trace/audit materials. | Simulation evidence remains Layer 7-owned; Phase 14 cannot rerun or update policies. |
| Layer 8 — StressForge-Lite Stress Generator | Supplies stress profiles, schedules, stress metrics, validity reports, matched clean/stressed lineage, and failure taxonomy. | Stress records remain Layer 8-owned; stress schedules are not mutated. |
| Layer 9 — MyoSuite/OpenSim Embodiment Demo | Supplies embodiment state/outcome, command timeline, endpoint-error, safety-event, reward-trace, demo manifest, and optional OpenSim branch artifacts. | Embodiment records remain Layer 9-owned; Phase 14 cannot control simulators or infer biomechanics. |
| Layer 10 — Dashboard, Cards, and Reproducibility | Loads, validates, indexes, summarizes, views, renders, cards, exports, manifests, warns, and logs. | Produces derived dashboard/reproducibility artifacts only; not hidden primary evidence. |

**Primary Layer 10 modules participating.** `Record loader`, `Schema validator`, `Record indexer`, `Metric summarizer`, `View model builder`, `View renderer`, `Card generator`, `Export manager`, `Manifest builder`, `Warning engine`, and `Audit logger`. `[ARCH: Layer 10 internal module architecture]`

**Feed-forward path.** Phases 0–13 source records and evaluation artifacts feed Layer 10; Layer 10 emits derived metrics/views/cards/figures/tables/manifests/logs; these feed Phase 15, Layer 0 review, repository/reproducibility packaging, and reviewer/examiner inspection. `[ARCH: Layer 10 feedforward]`

**Loopback restriction.** Layer 10 may emit missingness, schema-failure, lineage-gap, or claim-safety signals to upstream owners, but that signal is a visible repair/correction request or diagnostic flag, not an in-place mutation or hidden rerun. `[FRAME: back-propagation discipline]` `[ARCH: Layer 10 feedback restrictions]`

#### 5. Execution procedure

The following execution sequence is **[DERIVED from ARCH+REG+EXEC+EVAL+PRIOR+FRAME]**. It operationalizes the official Layer 10 dashboard/card/export/reproducibility obligations into ordered executor actions, but it does **not** create new canonical records, schemas, repository paths, classes, commands, algorithms, statistical run matrices, metric definitions, or thesis claims. Where concrete paths are registry-confirmed they are cited explicitly; otherwise manifest mapping and open-issue handling are used. `[FRAME: DERIVED rule]` `[FRAME: domain non-interference]`

1. **Freeze upstream evidence intake.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** Phase 0–13 handoff manifests, source record indexes, validation reports, open issues, diagnostic-only flags, negative-result notes.  
   **Action:** Create a Phase 14 intake inventory by source phase, source layer, record family, validation state, and branch status.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Consumes upstream records only; produces loaded-record inventory, missing-file inventory, and open-issue intake log as Layer 10 derived artifacts.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** Source ownership and immutability gate: no source record may be rewritten, renamed, or silently repaired.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Missing or invalid source records become visible missingness states, diagnostic-only outputs, or blocked exports. `[ARCH: Record loader]` `[REG: dashboard-readable source records]` `[PRIOR: Phase 13 handoff]`

2. **Validate schemas, statuses, and warning coverage.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** Loaded records, schema/version metadata, claim-safety tags, diagnostic-only labels, limitation tags, leakage warnings, policy-update/audit files, stress/embodiment branch manifests.  
   **Action:** Apply record-level and cross-record validation for required fields, schema versions, ID consistency, split legality, warning flags, update/frozen separation, stress lineage, embodiment lineage, and optional-branch status.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Produces validation log, missingness log, warning-coverage report, schema-error log, policy-update validation log where applicable, and branch-readiness status.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** Invalid records are excluded from thesis-ready outputs unless explicitly marked diagnostic-only and visible.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Failed schema, missing warning, missing policy-update trace, missing disabled-update audit, missing stress/embodiment manifest, or missing Layer 0 review blocks affected claim-facing exports. `[ARCH: Schema validator]` `[EVAL: diagnostic-only downgrade rules]`

3. **Resolve lineage and matched-comparison keys.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** Validated records, ID registry, run/config/seed manifests, split/preprocessing/label/model/calibration/threshold/policy/stress/embodiment identifiers, `MatchedComparisonReport`s.  
   **Action:** Build a cross-layer lineage index that links figures/tables/cards/views back to source records and fair-comparison keys.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Produces lineage graph or lookup table, record-to-view mapping, record-to-card mapping, matched-key completeness report, and unresolved-join report.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** Every comparative output must either be fully matched or explicitly diagnostic-only/partial/unmatched with reason.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Unresolved joins, missing matched-comparison keys, or ambiguous identifiers block superiority/improvement claims and create a Layer 10 warning. `[ARCH: Record indexer]` `[EVAL: matched-comparison rules]`

4. **Build metric definitions and dashboard metric records.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** Indexed records, metric dictionary entries/snapshots, evaluation outcomes, baseline/control summaries, reward/cost/stress/embodiment metrics, negative-result notes.  
   **Action:** Generate `DashboardMetricRecord` outputs only from saved records and defined metrics. Do not recompute hidden empirical evidence or retune operating points.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Produces `DashboardMetricRecord` rows, metric summary tables, metric-definition gap notes, baseline-sufficiency summary surfaces, and diagnostic-only metric flags.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** Every metric-bearing record must link to `MetricDictionaryEntry` / metric dictionary snapshot and source fields; comparative metrics must link to matched comparison status.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Missing metric dictionary entries, undefined formula/direction/denominator/unit, missing source fields, or post-hoc metric changes force diagnostic-only status. `[ARCH: Metric summarizer]` `[REG: DashboardMetricRecord]` `[EVAL: metric dictionary rule]`

5. **Build dashboard view records.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** `DashboardMetricRecord`s, lineage index, warning coverage report, view/page configuration, claim/evaluation lineage.  
   **Action:** Generate `DashboardViewRecord` outputs for project overview, dataset/protocol, decoder baseline, calibration/uncertainty/selective prediction, IHARQ, RegimeRisk, Adaptive-IHARQ, deferral, simulated closed-loop, bandit/RL, StressForge, Layer 9 embodiment, optional OpenSim branch, A0–A13 ablation, failure taxonomy, cards/export, and reproducibility pages or static equivalents.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Produces `DashboardViewRecord`s with filters, source metric IDs, source record IDs, completeness state, warning flags, export references, and claim/evaluation references.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** Filters must be reproducible and stored; view state must be one of complete, incomplete, blocked, stale, diagnostic-only, skipped, future-work-only, or not applicable with reason.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Hidden filters, untraceable views, stale sources, or missing warning flags make the view non-thesis-ready. `[ARCH: View model builder]` `[REG: DashboardViewRecord]`

6. **Generate or validate cards.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** Source cards, `DashboardMetricRecord`s, view records, source-record lineage, metric dictionaries, matched reports, limitation tags, warning flags, reproduction fields.  
   **Action:** Generate/validate `CardRecord` outputs and rendered cards for datasets, protocols, models, benchmarks, reliability, IHARQ, regime/trust, readiness policy, deferral, policy-update trace, contextual bandit/RL, closed-loop environment/session/rollout, stress, embodiment, safety-event, failure-taxonomy, limitation, artifact, and reproducibility contexts where source records exist.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Produces `CardRecord`s, rendered card files, card completeness report, card registry/index, and card-to-thesis mapping.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** Cards must include source records, metrics where metric-bearing, matched comparison IDs where comparison-bearing, limitation tags, warning flags, diagnostic-only state, reproduction fields, artifact paths, and thesis-usage references.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Cards missing source lineage or limitations are excluded from claim-supporting outputs. `[ARCH: Card generator]` `[REG: CardRecord]`

7. **Export static figures, tables, screenshots, and report bundles.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** `DashboardViewRecord`s, `DashboardMetricRecord`s, cards, export configuration, artifact identity contract, warning flags, metric dictionaries, matched reports, claim-evidence links.  
   **Action:** Export deterministic static figures, tables, cards, screenshots, and static dashboard/report bundles from saved records and view configurations.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Produces static figure artifacts, CSV/Parquet/Markdown/LaTeX-ready tables, rendered card bundles, screenshots where used, export logs, output hashes/checksums, and figure/table/card registry entries.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** Every artifact must include artifact ID/type/title, source records/layers, filters, generating page/script/config, run ID, metric dictionary ID where metric-bearing, matched-comparison ID where comparative, diagnostic-only status, claim-evidence ID where claim-facing, export path/time, warning flags, known limitations, checksum, and reproduction status.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Manual untracked figures, nondeterministic unversioned exports, missing lineage, or hidden recomputation block thesis-ready use. `[ARCH: Export manager]` `[REG: artifact identity contract]`

8. **Assemble manifests and reproducibility package.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** Source-record inventory, run registry, configs/hashes, seeds, tool/environment notes, schema versions, export logs, validation logs, warning logs, card completeness logs, artifact registry, metric dictionary export, matched report index, negative-result index, claim-evidence links.  
   **Action:** Build artifact manifest, export manifest/package index, `ReproducibilityManifest`, environment summary, run/config/seed index, source-record bundle index, and reproduction guide/package index.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Produces manifest files, package index, reproducibility report, validation and warning summaries, open issue inventory, and diagnostic-only status list.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** Manifest entries must enable a future reproducer to trace every thesis-used figure/table/card/view to source records, configs, versions, seeds, and warnings.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Missing configs, seeds, tool versions, source bundles, output hashes, or manifest links weaken or block reproducibility claims. `[ARCH: Reproducibility Manifest Builder]` `[REG: ReproducibilityManifest]`

9. **Apply warning engine and Layer 0 claim-safety gate.**  
   **Inputs consumed:** Layer 0 claim ledger/scope rules, warning flags, limitation templates, diagnostic-only labels, invalid-claim rules, claim-evidence views, generated figures/tables/cards/views.  
   **Action:** Attach warning flags to every relevant artifact; generate limitation and claim-safety summaries; block unsafe claim-facing exports; prepare Layer 0 review package.  
   **Records/artifacts:** Produces warning surfaces, limitation cards, claim-safety summary, blocked-export report, claim-evidence view/manifest links, and Layer 0 review bundle.  
   **Validation/checkpoint:** No claim-facing artifact may imply clinical validation, real patient safety, medical-device readiness, real rehabilitation efficacy, real muscle stimulation control, real assistive-control safety, or deployment readiness.  
   **Failure/downgrade:** Missing Layer 0 review or forbidden claim wording blocks Phase 15 claim-facing use. `[ARCH: Warning Engine and Claim-Safety Gate]` `[REG: InvalidClaimFlag]` `[EVAL: Layer 0 claim boundaries]`

10. **Finalize Phase 15 handoff and audit.**  
    **Inputs consumed:** All Phase 14 derived outputs, validation logs, manifests, open issues, BPCR status, diagnostic-only lists, negative-result index, warning coverage, Layer 0 review state.  
    **Action:** Produce the Phase 15 handoff package, final open-issue list, definition-of-done checklist, and machine-readable handoff block.  
    **Records/artifacts:** Produces Phase 15 artifact package, Layer 0 review package, reviewer/examiner package, repository/reproducibility package, and final Phase 14 handoff metadata.  
    **Validation/checkpoint:** The handoff is complete only if all required outputs are either produced and validated or explicitly marked missing, diagnostic-only, blocked, skipped, future-work-only, not applicable, or deferred with reason.  
    **Failure/downgrade:** If lineage, metric, matched-comparison, warning, claim-evidence, or manifest requirements fail, affected outputs stay diagnostic-only or blocked and cannot support Phase 15 claim-facing use. `[EXEC: Phase 14 to Phase 15 handoff]` `[FRAME: machine-readable handoff]`

#### 6. Output contract

Phase 14 outputs are derived, thesis-facing, dashboard-facing, audit-facing, or reproducibility-facing artifacts. They summarize and package saved evidence; they do not become new primary empirical evidence. Each output must preserve source lineage, validation status, limitation tags, metric dictionary linkage where metric-bearing, matched-comparison linkage where comparative, and Layer 0 status where claim-facing. `[ARCH: Layer 10 output contract]` `[REG: DashboardMetricRecord / DashboardViewRecord / CardRecord / ReproducibilityManifest]` `[EXEC: Phase 14 output contract]`

| Output family | Canonical / supported name | Owner | Mutability / versioning status | Validation status required | Claim status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dashboard metric records | `DashboardMetricRecord` | Layer 10 | Derived/versioned; regenerate with new ID or version when source records, filters, metric definitions, or warnings change. | Source lineage, metric dictionary, config/run, validation status, warning flags. | Not primary evidence; claim-ready only as traceable summary of source evidence. |
| Dashboard view records | `DashboardViewRecord` | Layer 10 | Derived/versioned; cannot silently overwrite thesis-ready views. | View/page IDs, source metrics, filters, source records, completeness state, warnings, export refs. | Inspectability evidence only. |
| Card records and rendered cards | `CardRecord`; rendered cards where generated | Layer 10 for generated cards; upstream source layers for pre-existing source cards | Derived card artifacts; version if template/source/warning changes. | Card completeness, lineage, warnings, limitations, reproduction fields. | Claim-supporting only if source evidence and Layer 0 review pass. |
| Static figures/tables/screenshots | Figure/table artifacts with artifact identity contract; `FigureTableManifest` where used | Layer 10 export manager | Derived export artifacts; immutable once thesis-ready except by versioned regeneration. | Source IDs, config, run ID, metric dictionary, matched report where relevant, warnings, checksum. | Not primary evidence; thesis-ready only through source linkage. |
| Metric dictionary exports/snapshots | `MetricDictionaryEntry`; `MetricDictionary` | Evaluation framework / Layer 10 export view | Snapshot or manifest-linked export; exact schema/path may require confirmation. | Definition, formula/source fields, direction, units, version, owner. | Required for metric claims. |
| Matched-comparison report index/views | `MatchedComparisonReport` | Evaluation framework / Layer 10 export view | Derived index/view; source report immutable. | Matched keys and missingness status. | Required for fair-comparison claims. |
| Negative-result note index | `NegativeResultNote` index/view | Evaluation framework / Layer 10 export view | Derived index/view; source notes immutable. | Negative/failure/missingness state, affected artifacts, limitation tags. | Required for null/failure/baseline-sufficiency visibility. |
| Diagnostic-only status exports | `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` / diagnostic-only status list | Evaluation / Layer 0 / Layer 10 surface | Derived status export; must inherit upstream flags. | Cause, affected record/artifact, claim consequence. | Blocks strong claim use. |
| Claim-evidence views | `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` views / `ClaimEvidenceManifest` links with alias caveat | Layer 0 / Phase 15 interface; Layer 10 renders | Derived claim trace; alias caveat preserved until resolved. | Claim IDs, artifacts, limitations, warning flags, diagnostic states, review status. | Required before claim-facing Phase 15 use. |
| Manifests and package indexes | Artifact manifest, export manifest/package index, `ReproducibilityManifest`, run/config/seed/source bundle indexes | Layer 10 / repository package | Generated/versioned; must not fabricate missing source assets. | Paths or manifest mappings, versions, checksums, source records, environment/tool notes. | Reproducibility/traceability evidence only. |
| Logs and reports | Validation logs, export logs, warning logs, missingness logs, card-completeness logs, policy-update trace validation logs | Layer 10 | Append-only or versioned derived logs. | Run/config/source IDs, status, failure classes, downgrades. | Audit evidence; not performance evidence. |

##### 7.1 Artifact immutability and versioning rules

1. **Upstream source records are immutable.** Phase 14 may read and index Phases 0–13 outputs, but it must not change their contents, validation statuses, split labels, action tokens, stress schedules, policy outputs, or simulator outcomes. `[FRAME: immutable upstream records]` `[REG: dashboard source-vs-derived separation]`

2. **Derived outputs are versioned.** `DashboardMetricRecord`, `DashboardViewRecord`, `CardRecord`, figures, tables, manifests, and logs must receive new IDs, versions, output hashes, or export timestamps when source records, filters, metric definitions, templates, warnings, or export settings change. `[ARCH: DashboardViewRecord regeneration rule]`

3. **Lineage fields are mandatory.** Every Phase 14 output must include or manifest-link source record IDs, source layer, producer phase, run ID, config hash, schema version, validation status, warning flags, limitation tags, metric dictionary ID where metric-bearing, matched-comparison ID where comparative, negative-result note ID where relevant, and claim-evidence ID where claim-facing. `[EXEC: Phase 14 lineage fields]`

4. **Claim state is explicit.** Each output must be classified as claim-ready, diagnostic-only, blocked, optional/stretch-only, future-work-only, skipped-non-blocking, not applicable with reason, or not-primary-evidence. `[EVAL: sub-ablation status vocabulary]`

5. **Repair is not overwrite.** If Phase 14 discovers an upstream schema, lineage, match-key, or warning defect, it may create a diagnostic flag, validation overlay, missingness report, exclusion, or Back-Propagation Correction Request, but not a silent fix. `[FRAME: Back-Propagation Correction Request]`

6. **Static export fallback is valid only with full traceability.** A static export package may substitute for an interactive dashboard only if the same manifest, warning, lineage, card, diagnostic-only, negative-result, and Layer 0 review requirements pass. `[EXEC: Phase 14 minimum successful phase]`

#### 8. Validation gates and exit criteria

| Gate | Required check | Pass status | Failure handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| Entry gate | Prior Phase 0–13 handoffs exist or are explicitly missing/skipped/diagnostic; source documents and prior playbook are available. | Phase 14 can begin intake. | Missing required cumulative playbook would block; missing branch source becomes visible incomplete/skipped status. |
| Saved-record-only gate | Layer 10 reads saved records, manifests, metric dictionaries, matched reports, note indexes, and templates only. | Derived outputs allowed. | Hidden recomputation blocks Phase 14 exit or creates invalid claim-facing artifact. |
| Schema/completeness gate | Consumed records and produced Layer 10 records validate against schemas or declared schema-status candidates. | Valid records may be rendered/exported. | Invalid records excluded, diagnostic-only, or blocked; unresolved schema carried to open issues. |
| Source ownership gate | Source records remain owned by producing layers and are not mutated by Layer 10. | Source-vs-derived boundary preserved. | Source mutation invalidates affected export/comparison. |
| Lineage gate | Every view/card/figure/table/export has source IDs, config IDs/hashes, run IDs, schema versions, warnings, limitations, and checksum/output hash where applicable. | Thesis-ready export eligible. | Missing lineage blocks or downgrades affected artifact. |
| Metric dictionary gate | Every thesis-facing metric has definition, direction, unit, formula/source fields, and metric dictionary ID/snapshot. | Metric claim eligible subject to Layer 0. | Undefined metrics diagnostic-only. |
| Matched-comparison gate | Comparative claims have matched keys and `MatchedComparisonReport`, or explicitly accepted partial/unmatched diagnostic status. | Fair-comparison claim eligible. | Unmatched comparisons cannot support improvement/superiority claims. |
| Negative-result gate | Null, failed, baseline-sufficient, skipped, incomplete, or diagnostic-only outcomes have visible `NegativeResultNote` or equivalent status. | Negative evidence preserved. | Hidden negative result blocks claim-facing export. |
| Warning coverage gate | Public-data/proxy/simulation/stress/embodiment/diagnostic/clinical-non-claim warnings are present in all relevant artifacts. | Warning-safe export eligible. | Missing warnings block export. |
| Card completeness gate | Cards include source lineage, metrics where relevant, limitations, reproduction fields, warnings, diagnostic status, and thesis usage. | Card may be handed to Phase 15. | Incomplete cards cannot support claims. |
| Export determinism gate | Exports from same records/configs are deterministic or differences are versioned. | Export package reproducible. | Untracked nondeterminism blocks thesis-ready status. |
| Policy-update separation gate | `PolicyUpdateTrace`, disabled-update audit, `policy_update_filter`, training/adaptation curves, and held-out frozen-evaluation curves are separated where A10/A11/update-enabled views are present. | Policy-learning views may be displayed with simulation-only warnings. | Mixed curves invalid or diagnostic-only. |
| Stress/embodiment/OpenSim branch gate | Stress and embodiment views preserve profile/schedule/config/tool/manifest/mapping branch status and limitations. | Optional/stretch views allowed with warnings. | Missing or unmanifested branch artifacts become diagnostic-only/skipped/future-work-only and must not affect lower tiers. |
| Layer 0 review gate | Claim-facing outputs pass Layer 0 limitation and forbidden-claim review. | Phase 15 claim-facing handoff allowed. | Missing/failed review blocks claim-facing export. |

**Exit condition.** Phase 14 exits successfully when it produces a traceable dashboard/export package in which every figure, table, card, view, screenshot, metric export, warning surface, manifest, and reproducibility artifact links to source records, configs, schemas, run IDs, metric dictionaries, matched reports where required, negative-result notes where relevant, claim-evidence entries where claim-facing, limitation tags, and Layer 0 review status. `[EXEC: Phase 14 exit condition]`

#### 9. Matched-comparison key preservation

Phase 14 must not create fairness by visualization. It must preserve the matched-comparison keys established by source phases and the evaluation protocol.

| Key family | Required Phase 14 preservation |
|---|---|
| Data/protocol keys | `dataset_id`, subject ID, session ID, trial/window ID, `split_id`, split role, preprocessing ID, label-map ID, label-budget ID where used. |
| Model/calibration keys | model ID / model-family ID, score schema, class order, calibration ID, threshold registry ID, operating-point ID where used. |
| Policy/simulation keys | policy ID, policy family, action-space version, reward/cost config, simulator/environment ID, update mode, `PolicyUpdateTrace` ID, disabled-update audit ID, seed, config hash. |
| Stress keys | `StressProfileRecord` ID, `StressScheduleRecord` ID, stress intensity/config, clean run ID, stressed run ID, matched clean/stressed pair, seed/config. |
| Embodiment/OpenSim keys | embodiment mode ID, adapter/simulator branch, command-mapping ID, endpoint-error source, safety-event ID/log, reward-trace ID, `Layer9EmbodimentDemoManifest`, OpenSim manifest/branch status where applicable. |
| Evaluation/export keys | A0–A13 ID, local sub-ablation ID where used, `EvaluationOutcomeRecord` ID where produced, `MetricDictionaryEntry` ID, `MatchedComparisonReport` ID, `NegativeResultNote` ID, diagnostic-only status, `DashboardMetricRecord` ID, `DashboardViewRecord` ID, card/export/artifact ID, claim-evidence ID. |

If a required key is missing, Phase 14 must display the missing key family, mark the affected comparison as diagnostic-only or blocked, and prevent improvement/superiority language in Phase 15. `[EVAL: matched-key envelope]`

#### 10. Ablation and evaluation obligations

Phase 14 exposes and packages A0–A13 evaluation artifacts. It does not own the underlying ablation evidence and must not introduce A14.

| Ablation ID | Official normalized identity | Phase 14 obligation |
|---|---|---|
| A0 | raw decoder baseline | Display raw decoder/baseline metrics from source records with metric dictionary linkage, matched-comparison status where used, and negative-result/baseline-sufficiency visibility. |
| A1 | calibrated decoder baseline | Display calibration deltas, reliability diagrams, and calibration split legality with metric definitions and leakage warnings. |
| A2 | simple registered threshold / confidence-threshold baseline | Display registered threshold/retained-coverage/retained-accuracy views from threshold/selective records and matched operating-point tables. |
| A3 | uncertainty and selective prediction | Display uncertainty/selective-prediction and risk-coverage summaries with matched cost/coverage controls and diagnostic-only gaps. |
| A4 | longer-window, multi-window voting/averaging, and ordinary ensemble controls | Display ordinary-combination controls and baseline-sufficiency notes without treating them as IHARQ or selective-prediction evidence. |
| A5 | IHARQ-lite | Display IHARQ decision-flow, canonical action tokens, reason codes, fallback/unsafe summaries, and matched IHARQ-lite comparisons where validated. |
| A6 | IHARQ + evidence-quality estimator | Display evidence-quality estimator outputs from Phase 6 and A6-compatible upstream evidence from Phase 4 with producer/variant tags preserved; do not treat Phase 4 alone as completing A6. |
| A7 | IHARQ + RegimeRisk | Display temporal trust/regime-aware views, stop-loss/warning visibility, and temporal limitations where Phase 5 outputs exist. |
| A8 | learning-to-defer | Display deferral/fallback/cost/coverage views with cost assumptions and fallback source lineage. |
| A9 | supervised Adaptive-IHARQ | Display supervised readiness-policy actions under pseudo-label/proxy limitations and matched-comparison requirements. |
| A10 | contextual bandit | Display simulation-bounded immediate-reward adaptation, update traces, reward/regret summaries, and held-out frozen evaluation separately. |
| A11 | RL policy | Display simulation-bounded sequential policy rollouts, reward/safety/invalid-action warnings, update traces, seed/reward sensitivity, and frozen-evaluation separation. |
| A12 | stress tests | Display stress profiles/schedules, stress sensitivity, matched clean/stressed comparisons, stress validity, negative-result notes, and stress-only/proxy warnings. |
| A13 | MyoSuite/OpenSim/static-replay embodiment demonstration | Display Layer 9 embodiment demo and optional OpenSim branch status with endpoint-error, command timeline, safety-event, reward-trace, manifest, and simulation/proxy-only limitations. |

Required evaluation artifacts for thesis-facing views: `EvaluationOutcomeRecord` or equivalent source evaluation record where produced, `MetricDictionaryEntry` / metric dictionary snapshot, `MatchedComparisonReport` where a comparison is claimed, `NegativeResultNote` when results are null/failed/incomplete/skipped/diagnostic-only, `DiagnosticOnlyFlag` or diagnostic-only status, `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` view / `ClaimEvidenceManifest` link with alias caveat, `DashboardMetricRecord` and `DashboardViewRecord` lineage, `CardRecord` or card/source bundle where carded, and export/artifact manifest entry. `[EVAL: A0–A13 obligations]` `[EXEC: Phase 14 evaluation-artifact linkage]`

#### 11. Dashboard, card, and reproducibility obligations

**Source-vs-derived separation.**

| Category | Phase 14 examples | Boundary rule |
|---|---|---|
| Dashboard-readable source records | Records produced by Phases 1–13 and owned by Layers 1–9. | May be read, validated, summarized, visualized, carded, and exported; must not be overwritten. |
| Dashboard-warning inputs | Claim-safety tags, limitation labels, diagnostic-only flags, negative-result notes, leakage warnings, branch status, policy-update/frozen labels. | Must be displayed where relevant; missing warning blocks export. |
| Dashboard-generated derived outputs | `DashboardMetricRecord`, `DashboardViewRecord`, `CardRecord`, static figures, tables, screenshots, export logs, manifests, `ReproducibilityManifest`. | Must trace to source records and remain derived, not primary evidence. |
| Dashboard-export manifest inputs | Run registry, configs/hashes, seeds, schema versions, metric dictionaries, matched reports, claim-evidence entries, environment files, output hashes. | Required for Phase 15 and reproducibility appendix. |
| Not-dashboard inputs | Unvalidated arrays, manual screenshots, informal spreadsheets, notebook-only summaries, unversioned temporary outputs. | Must not be consumed as evidence. |

**Required page or static-export families.** Project overview and claim-safety; dataset/protocol/split/preprocessing/label-map/source limitation; decoder baselines and low-calibration curves; calibration/uncertainty/selective prediction/threshold/reliability/high-confidence-wrong/leakage; IHARQ decision flow and evidence-quality/fallback/unsafe events; RegimeRisk/trust timeline; Adaptive-IHARQ/readiness policy; learning-to-defer cost/coverage; simulated closed-loop session/rollout/reward/environment/safety; contextual-bandit and RL with update trace and frozen/update separation; StressForge profiles/schedules/sensitivity/validity; Layer 9 embodiment; Phase 13 OpenSim optional replay/comparison or skip/future-work; A0–A13 ablation/comparison; failure taxonomy/negative results; cards/export; reproducibility package/artifact manifest. `[ARCH: dashboard page specifications]`

**Required cards where source records exist.** Dataset, protocol, decoder/model/benchmark, calibration/reliability, IHARQ decision/evidence, RegimeRisk/regime/trust, controller/readiness-policy, deferral, policy-update trace, contextual-bandit/RL, closed-loop environment/session/rollout, stress, embodiment, safety-event, failure-taxonomy, limitation, artifact, and reproducibility cards. Cards must include source lineage, metric dictionary references where metric-bearing, matched-comparison IDs where comparison-bearing, warnings, limitations, diagnostic-only status, reproduction fields, artifact paths, and thesis-usage references. `[ARCH: Card generator]` `[REG: CardRecord]`

**Reproducibility package.** The package must include artifact manifest; `ReproducibilityManifest`; dashboard/export configuration; run registry and source run IDs; schema versions; source record bundle index; metric dictionary export/snapshot; matched-comparison report index; negative-result note index; claim-evidence view/manifest link; card completeness report; validation/warning/export logs and checksums; environment/tool version notes; open issue list; diagnostic-only status list; package index for Phase 15. `[ARCH: Reproducibility Manifest Builder]`

#### 12. Claim-safety and limitation boundaries

**Allowed Phase 14 claim classes.** Phase 14 may support bounded claims about dashboard/read-only inspectability, record-to-figure traceability, card completeness, limitation visibility, artifact manifest completeness, reproducibility packaging, metric dictionary visibility, matched-comparison visibility, negative-result visibility, diagnostic-only/missingness visibility, warning coverage, and claim-safety review readiness. It may also display bounded upstream evidence categories such as public EEG reliability evidence, low-calibration evidence, calibration/uncertainty visibility, IHARQ evidence-verification display, temporal trust monitoring display, adaptive readiness-policy evaluation display, simulation-only closed-loop display, stress-conditioned robustness display, and simulation/proxy-only embodiment-demo display. `[EXEC: Phase 14 allowed claims]`

**Forbidden Phase 14 claim classes.** Phase 14 must not support or imply clinical BCI-FES validation, real patient safety, medical-device readiness, real rehabilitation efficacy, real muscle stimulation control, real deployment readiness, real assistive-control safety, real-time clinical dashboard readiness, patient-specific biomechanical validation, actual therapeutic benefit, or real-world stress/fatigue diagnosis. `[ARCH: Layer 0 non-claim boundaries]`

**Required propagated limitation tags.** `public_eeg_only`, `low_calibration_protocol`, `proxy_readiness`, `pseudo_label_based` where applicable, `evaluation_only`, `simulation_only`, `stress_conditioned`, `embodiment_proxy_only`, `MyoSuite_OpenSim_demo_only`, `diagnostic_only` where applicable, `future_work_only` where applicable, `skipped_non_blocking` where applicable, `not_clinical_validation`, `not_real_patient_safety`, `not_medical_device_readiness`, `not_real_rehabilitation_efficacy`, `not_real_muscle_stimulation_control`, `not_deployment_readiness`, and `not_real_assistive_control_safety`.

**Layer 0 review package.** Phase 14 hands Layer 0 intended claim wording attached to figures/tables/cards, claim-evidence views and matrix/manifest links, limitation and warning coverage report, diagnostic-only and blocked-export lists, simulation/proxy/stress/embodiment/OpenSim warnings, forbidden-claim checklist, negative-result index, and open-issue inventory.

#### 13. Failure, missingness, and diagnostic-only handling

| Failure mode | Risk | Required Phase 14 handling |
|---|---|---|
| Cosmetic dashboard | Looks complete but does not answer thesis inspection questions. | Link every page to records, metrics, claims, limitations, cards, ablations, and reproducibility artifacts. |
| Hidden experiment engine | Dashboard recomputes/tunes results outside upstream records. | Enforce saved-record-only gate; new run ID/config/output record required for any legitimate upstream rerun outside Phase 14. |
| Hidden missing records | Thesis appears more complete than evidence allows. | Show missingness and incomplete states in pages/cards/manifests. |
| Missing limitations | Cards/figures overclaim. | Card completeness and Layer 0 warning coverage required. |
| Missing metric dictionary | Tables/figures are irreproducible. | Metric-bearing outputs diagnostic-only until definitions exist. |
| Missing matched keys | Visual comparisons imply unfair improvement. | Require `MatchedComparisonReport`; unmatched comparisons are diagnostic-only. |
| Mixed policy update/frozen evaluation | Adaptive methods look stronger than they are. | Require `PolicyUpdateTrace`, disabled-update audits, `policy_update_filter`, and separate exports. |
| Missing stress/embodiment warnings | Proxy outputs appear clinically meaningful. | Propagate stress/proxy/simulation/embodiment warnings to every derived artifact. |
| Optional OpenSim promoted to core | Optional Phase 13 branch appears to control thesis validity. | Display optional branch state and skip/future-work/non-blocking status. |
| Manual untracked figures | Thesis artifact cannot be reproduced. | Require export manager, checksums, artifact IDs, and audit logs. |
| Layer 0 review absent | Unsafe claim wording enters thesis. | Block claim-facing export until review passes. |

Phase 14 must mark affected outputs diagnostic-only or blocked when source records are missing, source IDs fail to join, validation is failed/unresolved, metric dictionary references are missing, comparison matching is incomplete, warnings/limitations are missing, negative-result notes are absent for known failures, filters are unreproducible, source ownership is ambiguous, policy-update traces or disabled-update audits are missing where required, stress schedule/profile lineage is missing, embodiment mode/command mapping/demo manifest lineage is missing, Phase 13 OpenSim manifest/mapping limitation is missing where OpenSim is displayed, Layer 0 review is absent, or repository paths are unresolved without manifest mapping. `[EVAL: diagnostic-only downgrade rules]`

Suggested visible missingness/status vocabulary: `complete`, `incomplete_missing_source`, `incomplete_missing_metric_dictionary`, `incomplete_missing_matched_comparison`, `incomplete_missing_claim_evidence`, `incomplete_missing_warning`, `blocked_export`, `diagnostic_only`, `skipped_non_blocking`, `future_work_only`, `not_applicable_with_reason`, `stale_source_record`, and `schema_validation_failed`. These are procedural display states and must not be treated as new canonical registry enumerations unless the registry later confirms them. `[DERIVED from EXEC: Phase 14 missingness states + EVAL: status vocabulary]`

#### 13A. Back-Propagation Correction Request handling

No immediate Back-Propagation Correction Request is opened by this Phase 14 playbook-generation section because the current task generated a procedure from provided documents and did not validate actual executed records. However, actual Phase 14 execution must create a formal Back-Propagation Correction Request instead of silently repairing prior outputs when any of the following source-grounded conditions are observed:

- a prior phase output required by Phase 14 is absent despite being declared complete;
- a source record fails schema validation or lacks required source IDs;
- matched-comparison keys conflict across source records;
- metric dictionary entries are missing for already-claim-facing metrics;
- Layer 0 warning/limitation tags required by the source documents are absent;
- policy-update traces or disabled-update audits are missing for update/frozen views that earlier phases declared claim-facing;
- stress/embodiment/OpenSim branch status contradicts the prior handoff;
- a prior figure/card/table claims thesis-ready status without manifest lineage.

Required request structure during actual execution:

```yaml
back_propagation_request:
  request_id: "BPCR-P14-<short-id>"
  discovered_in_phase: "P14"
  affected_prior_phase: "P<source-phase>"
  affected_artifact_or_record: "<canonical name or GAP>"
  affected_source_record_ids: []
  issue_type: "naming_mismatch | missing_record | schema_failure | lineage_gap | matched_key_mismatch | leakage_risk | invalid_status | unsupported_claim | stale_artifact | other"
  severity: "blocking | claim_limiting | diagnostic_only_risk | non_blocking | optional_stretch"
  source_conflict: []
  downstream_risk: []
  required_action: "revalidate | regenerate | exclude | add_overlay | update_registry_decision_needed | user_confirmation_needed | other"
  whether_current_phase_can_continue: "yes | no | diagnostic_only | partial | requires_confirmation"
  diagnostic_only_effect: "none | current_phase_only | downstream_phases | affected_ablation_only | requires_confirmation"
  claim_safety_effect: []
  layer10_visibility_required: true
  layer0_review_required: true
  notes: ""
```

Any such request is a visible governance object. It is not permission to mutate accepted Phase 0–13 text or overwrite upstream canonical records. `[FRAME: Back-Propagation Correction Request template]`

#### 14. Repository, storage, and reproducibility expectations

Phase 14 must use registry-confirmed Layer 10 storage homes where they exist and manifest mapping for everything still unresolved. It must not invent final UI technology, final thesis placement, non-core export package layout, class names, commands, or implementation-only paths. `[REG: Layer 10 canonical paths]` `[FRAME: implementation-domain boundary]`

| Storage family | Phase 14 expectation | Path status |
|---|---|---|
| Dashboard metric records | Store `DashboardMetricRecord` outputs with source records/layers, metric dictionary IDs, filters, warnings, run/config IDs, and validation status. | Registry-confirmed explicit home: `records/dashboard_metric_records/`. |
| Dashboard view records | Store `DashboardViewRecord` outputs with page/panel IDs, metric IDs, filters, warning flags, export refs, checksum, and view state. | Registry-confirmed explicit home: `records/dashboard_view_records/`. |
| Card records and rendered card files | Store `CardRecord` records and rendered cards with card IDs, types, versions, source records, metrics, limitations, reproduction command/fields where supported, and diagnostic status. | Registry-confirmed homes: `records/card_records/` and `cards/`; exact rendered-card substructure/template details remain open where not specified. |
| Reproducibility manifest | Store `ReproducibilityManifest` with record bundle, configs, seeds, tool versions, scripts or script references, checksums, and package index. | Registry-confirmed explicit file: `manifests/reproducibility_manifest.yaml`. |
| Static figures and thesis tables | Store figures/tables with artifact IDs, source lineage, metric/match links, checksums, warnings, and thesis usage references. | Supported output family; exact final thesis numbering and placement deferred to Phase 15 / Paper and Thesis Evidence Map. |
| Dashboard app/static export | Store interactive app or static dashboard export package from saved records and view configs. | Interactive technology is optional; static package can pass; exact non-core export layout remains implementation-deferred unless manifest-confirmed. |
| Export/package manifests | Store artifact manifest, export manifest/package index, run registry links, metric dictionary export/snapshot, and claim-evidence views. | Required by architecture/execution plan; exact export manifest schema/layout remains open where not registry-confirmed. |
| Logs | Store validation logs, warning logs, export logs, missingness logs, card-completeness logs, policy-update trace validation logs, and audit logs. | Supported as audit/log family; exact implementation path may be manifest-mapped. |
| Claim-evidence views | Store claim-evidence links with `ClaimEvidenceMatrix` / `ClaimEvidenceManifest` alias caveat preserved. | Requires final registry reconciliation; manifest links must preserve both names where predecessor artifacts do. |
| Negative-result index | Store index of `NegativeResultNote` entries and export-validation failures. | Exact path via manifest. |
| Open issue list | Store registry/open-issue status used by Phase 14 and Phase 15. | Required for transparency. |

Every stored Phase 14 output must include or manifest-link: `artifact_id` or `record_id`, artifact type, source record IDs, source layers, run ID, config hash, schema version, producer module, phase ID, ablation ID where applicable, metric dictionary ID where applicable, matched-comparison ID where applicable, negative-result note ID where applicable, claim-evidence ID where claim-facing, warning flags, limitation tags, validation status, export path, export timestamp, checksum/output hash, thesis usage reference where applicable, and reproduction status. `[EXEC: Phase 14 repository expectations]`

#### 17. Definition of done

Phase 14 is complete when all of the following are true:

- Phase 0–13 predecessor sections remain unchanged and Phase 14 is append-only.
- Official identity `Phase 14 — Dashboard and cards` is preserved.
- Consumed source records from Phases 1–13 are validated, explicitly missing, skipped, future-work-only, diagnostic-only, or blocked.
- Layer 10 reads saved records only and does not mutate upstream records or recompute hidden experimental logic.
- `DashboardMetricRecord` outputs exist for dashboard metrics with source records, filters, metric dictionary links where metric-bearing, matched-comparison links where comparative, warning flags, diagnostic-only status, and export/card links.
- `DashboardViewRecord` outputs exist for pages/panels with page IDs, metric IDs, filters, source links, warnings, completeness states, evaluation lineage, export references, and checksums where applicable.
- `CardRecord` outputs and rendered cards include source records, metric references, limitations, warning flags, reproduction fields, artifact paths, and thesis usage references.
- Every exported figure, table, screenshot, card, and dashboard page satisfies the artifact identity contract.
- Metric dictionary entries/snapshots exist for every thesis-facing metric; otherwise affected outputs are diagnostic-only.
- Matched-comparison reports or matched-key status exist for every comparative claim; otherwise comparisons are diagnostic-only.
- Negative-result notes, baseline-sufficiency notes, missingness states, and diagnostic-only labels are indexed and visible.
- A0–A13 views are exposed as evaluation metadata only and never as artifact owners.
- C0–C4 are displayed only as claim-maturity/stopping-point summaries, not phases or artifact owners.
- Policy-update trace cards, disabled-update audit tables, and `policy_update_filter` values are present where contextual-bandit/RL/update-enabled evidence appears.
- Training/adaptation curves are separated from held-out frozen-policy evaluation curves.
- Stress-conditioned views preserve stress profile/schedule/run-manifest, seed/config, clean/stressed pairing, and stress-only/proxy warnings.
- Embodiment views preserve embodiment mode, command mapping, endpoint error, safety-event, reward-trace, demo-manifest, and embodiment-proxy limitations.
- Phase 13 OpenSim outputs, if displayed, preserve optional branch status, output manifest, mapping limitations, comparison status, and non-clinical/non-blocking warnings.
- Layer 0 claim-safety review passes for all claim-facing outputs.
- Artifact manifest, export manifest/package index, and `ReproducibilityManifest` are generated and validated.
- Export determinism, card completeness, warning coverage, missingness visibility, schema validation, and manifest integrity gates pass.
- Repository/storage expectations are manifest-linked and unresolved path/schema/name issues remain explicit.
- Open issues and confirmation requests are carried forward to Phase 15.
- Machine-readable handoff is complete.

Phase 15 is the final evidence-to-claim integration gate. It converts validated upstream source records, evaluation artifacts, Layer 10 exports, negative-result records, limitation tags, and reproducibility manifests into a claim-safe final thesis package. It does **not** create new empirical model evidence, retune thresholds, rerun calibrators, train policies, generate new stress profiles, run new embodiment experiments, or promote dashboard/card outputs into primary evidence. `[ARCH: Final demonstration / connection to implementation pipeline]` `[REG: Layer 0 / Layer 10 boundaries]` `[EXEC: Phase 15 final integration]` `[EVAL: protocol-wide diagnostic-only and negative-result discipline]`

#### 1. Phase identity, scope, and non-scope

| Field | Phase 15 value |
|---|---|
| Phase ID | `Phase 15` |
| Official phase title | `Final thesis integration` |
| Primary purpose | Integrate validated evidence, dashboard exports, metrics, matched comparisons, negative results, limitations, and reproducibility artifacts into a final claim-safe thesis evidence package. |
| Primary thesis role | Terminal evidence-to-claim gate: it determines which claims are thesis-ready, narrowed, diagnostic-only, optional-only, future-work-only, blocked, or forbidden. |
| Primary active governance layers | `Layer 0 — Claim-Safety and Scope Governance`; `Layer 10 — Dashboard, Cards, and Reproducibility Layer`. |
| Source-evidence layers | Layers 1–9 remain the owners of their source records and empirical/simulation/proxy evidence. Phase 15 does not transfer ownership. |
| Scope | Thesis-ready manuscript-section evidence integration; claim-to-artifact mapping; final claim map; final claim review; final limitation map; negative-result register/index; final demonstration scope/evidence/interpretation synthesis where used; final export inventory; repository-release checklist; reproducibility guide/package integrity; final tier/status summary; final thesis evidence-readiness handoff. |
| Non-scope | No retraining, recalibration, threshold tuning, pseudo-label creation, policy learning, stress generation, embodiment rerun, hidden metric recomputation, source-record repair, final statistical run-matrix design, final figure/table placement, final citation selection, or unsupported final thesis prose/claim generation. Phase 15 may prepare evidence-linked thesis section packages, but final narrative wording belongs to thesis-writing/evidence-map work. |
| Completion meaning | Actual Phase 15 is complete only when all final claim-facing outputs can be traced to source records, metric definitions, matched reports where comparative, warnings, negative results, diagnostic-only flags, Layer 10 exports, and Layer 0 claim decisions. |

[DERIVED from ARCH+REG+EXEC+EVAL+PRIOR+FRAME] Phase 15 should be executed as a read-only integration and validation workflow over prior evidence, followed by versioned final synthesis artifacts and explicit claim-safety decisions. This derived workflow does not introduce new canonical records or implementation internals.

#### 1A. Capability-tier and thesis-validity relevance

| Capability / thesis-validity item | Phase 15 relevance | Failure or partial-completion consequence |
|---|---|---|
| C0 baseline/public-data spine | Finalizes whether Phase 1–3 public-data, decoder, calibration, threshold, uncertainty, and ordinary-control evidence is thesis-ready. | If source lineage, metrics, or matching fail, C0 comparison claims are narrowed or diagnostic-only. |
| C1 IHARQ / temporal trust | Integrates A5 IHARQ-lite and A7 RegimeRisk claims only when Phase 4/5 records, reason codes, temporal trust records, matched reports, and negative results are present. | Missing IHARQ/RegimeRisk lineage weakens C1; threshold/ordinary-control sufficiency must be reported. |
| C2 adaptive/defer policy evidence | Integrates A6/A8/A9 evidence only with legal pseudo-labels, evidence-quality variants, cost/proxy labels, policy records, and split-safe frozen evaluation. | Adaptive claims become diagnostic-only or narrowed if proxy labels, policy lineage, or comparator matching fail. |
| C3 simulation/stress/policy-learning evidence | Integrates A10/A11/A12 evidence with simulation-only, stress-conditioned, update-trace, reward/cost, clean/stressed pairing, and frozen-evaluation limitations. | C3 can be diagnostic-only without blocking C0–C2 if labeled correctly. |
| C4 embodiment/OpenSim/static replay | Integrates A13 simulated embodiment and optional OpenSim/static-replay outputs as proxy-only/stretch evidence. | Missing/weak optional embodiment/OpenSim evidence is optional-only, diagnostic-only, skipped, or future-work-only; it must not block C0–C3. |
| Thesis validity | Phase 15 is required for any final thesis-ready claim because it provides the claim-to-artifact, limitation, negative-result, and reproducibility closure. | Without Phase 15, upstream evidence may exist but final thesis claims remain non-thesis-ready. |

Required limitation labels include public-data-only, low-calibration/protocol-specific, evaluation-only, proxy-readiness, pseudo-label-based where applicable, simulation-only, stress-conditioned, embodiment-proxy-only, optional-only, diagnostic-only, future-work-only, not-clinical-validation, not-real-patient-safety, not-medical-device-readiness, not-real-rehabilitation-efficacy, not-real-muscle-stimulation-control, not-deployment-readiness, and not-real-assistive-control-safety. `[ARCH: Layer 0 limitations]` `[REG: ScopeLabel / LimitationStatement]` `[EVAL: Layer 0 boundaries]`
